  4. Turn pressure cooker on to "saute" and add cornstarch mixture, heavy whipping cream and cheddar cheese.
  5. Cook for about 3-4 minutes while stirring constantly until soup thickens and cheese melts.
Hot Cheesy Black Bean and Corn Dip
Adapted from https://www.alohadreams.com/black-bean-and-corn-dip/
Ingredients
  • 2 (15 ounce) cans yellow corn drained
  • 1 (15 ounce) can black beans drained & rinsed
  • 1 (10 ounce) can Mild Rotel drained, (diced tomatoes with mild green chilies)
  • 2 (8 ounce) packets cream cheese softened & diced
  • 1 (16 ounce) container sour cream
  • 1 ½ teaspoon season salt
  • ½ teaspoon chili powder
  • 1 ½ teaspoon garlic powder
  • 1 teaspoon cumin
  • 2 cups shredded Mexican blend cheese (8 ounces), divided
Steps
  1. Bring the cream cheese to room temperature. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
  2. Drain the corn and rotel and add to a medium-size bowl. Drain and rinse the black beans and add to the bowl. Stir in the cream cheese, chili powder, garlic powder, seasoned salt, cumin and 1 cup shredded cheese. Stir together to incorporate.
  3. Pour into a 9 x 13 baking dish and spread evenly. Top with remaining 1 cup shredded cheese.
  4. Bake for approximately 25 to 30 minutes, or until cheese has melted and mixture is bubbly.
Chicken and Asparagus Stir Fry
Adapted from https://www.joyousapron.com/chicken-and-asparagus-stir-fry/
Ingredients
  • 1 lbs chicken breast or chicken tenders
  • 7 oz asparagus
  • 1 carrot
  • 5-6 cloves garlic
  • A few slices fresh ginger or 1/4 tsp ground ginger
  • vegetable oil
    • Stir Fry Sauce:
  • 3 tbsp oyster (flavored) sauce
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1 tbsp sesame oil
  • 1/2 tbsp rice wine
  • 1 tsp sugar
  • 1 tbsp water
  • 1/2 tsp corn starch
Steps
  1. Slice defrosted chicken into thin strips.
  2. In a small bowl, add stir fry sauce ingredients – oyster sauce, soy sauce, sesami oil, rice wine, sugar, water and corn starch. Mix well
  3. Slice asparagus and carrots. Mince garlic. Slice fresh ginger to create 5-6 thin slices of ginger.
  4. Add vegetable oil to wok or large skillet and heat up wok on high heat. Once wok is heated up, add asparagus and carrots and cook for 2-3 minutes or until almost done. Remove from wok and set aside.
  5. Add vegetable oil to wok. Once oil is heated up, add ginger and garlic. Wait for 30 seconds, then add chicken to the wok.
  6. Cook chicken for ~2 minutes, or until chicken is almost done. Add asparagus and carrots back into the wok, cook for 1 minute, add stir fry sauce, and cook for another 1-2 minutes, or until everything is fully cooked.
Clam Chowder
Adapted from https://www.tasteofhome.com/recipes/contest-winning-new-england-clam-chowder/
Servings: 5
Ingredients
  • 4 center-cut bacon strips
  • 2 celery ribs, chopped
  • 1 large onion, chopped
  • 1 garlic clove, minced
  • 3 small potatoes, peeled and cubed
  • 1 cup water
  • 1 bottle (8 ounces) clam juice
  • 3 teaspoons reduced-sodium chicken bouillon granules
  • 1/4 teaspoon white pepper
  • 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme
  • 1/3 cup all-purpose flour
  • 2 cups fat-free half-and-half, divided
  • 2 cans (6-1/2 ounces each) chopped clams, undrained
Steps
  1. In a Dutch oven, cook bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove to paper towels to drain; set aside. Saute celery and onion in the drippings until tender. Add garlic; cook 1 minute longer. Stir in the potatoes, water, clam juice, bouillon, pepper and thyme. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer, uncovered, until potatoes are tender, 15-20 minutes.
  2. In a small bowl, combine flour and 1 cup half-and-half until smooth. Gradually stir into soup. Bring to a boil; cook and stir until thickened, 1-2 minutes.
  3. Stir in clams and remaining half-and-half; heat through (do not boil). Crumble the cooked bacon; sprinkle over each serving.
Wild Alaskan Cod Fillets Omaha Steakhouse
Ingredients
  • 2 medium lemons, sliced
  • Salt & Pepper
  • 2 tbsp Mayo
  • 1/3 cup green yogurt
  • 1 tsp dill
  • 1 tsp Dijon
  • 1 tsp lemon juice
  • 5 drops hot sauce
Steps
  1. Thaw in refrigerator. When thawing, remove from plastic packaging. Cover and refrigerate below 38°F. Once thawed, consume within one to two days.
  2. SEAR ROAST: Preheat oven at 300°F. Pat dry and season desired number of fish fillets. Preheat an oven-proof skillet with 2 tsp. of cooking oil to medium-high. Carefully place cod in hot pan. Cook for 4 minutes on first side. Carefully flip fish then place skillet into preheated oven. Cook for 10-12 minutes or until fish is opaque and reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
  3. OVEN: Preheat oven to 350°F. Pat dry and season desired number of fish fillets. Place lemon slices and top with fillets on a lightly oiled, foil-lined baking sheet. Cook for 10-12 minutes or until fish is opaque and reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
  4. Combine remaining ingredients and stir frequently. Do not boil. Spoon over fish.
  5. PAN SAUTÉ: Pat dry and season desired number of fish fillets. Preheat a skillet with 2 tsp. of cooking oil to medium-high. Carefully place cod in pan and cook for 5-6 minutes. Flip and cook an additional 5-6 minutes or until fish is opaque and reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
  6. BROIL: Preheat broiler to high and position top rack 3-4" from broiler. Pat dry and season desired number of fish fillets. Brush with olive oil or melted butter, season, and place on an oven-proof, foil-lined baking sheet. Broil 4 minutes, flip fillets, and broil an additional 4 minutes or until fish is opaque and reaches an internal temperature of 145°F.
Faroe Islands Salmon Fillets Omaha Steakhouse
Ingredients
  • 4 pieces salmon
  • 2 tsp Cajun seasoning
  • 1 tsp thyme
  • 2 tbsp oil
  • 3 cloves garlic minced
  • 2 tbsp margarine reduced fat
  • ¾ cups fat free half & half
  • ½ cup chicken stock reduced fat
  • 2 bunches asparagus ends trimmed
  • 1 ½ cups mushrooms sliced
  • Salt/pepper to taste
Steps
  1. Thaw in Refrigerator. When thawing, remove from plastic packaging. Season salmon with Cajun seasoning, thyme, and salt/pepper. Cover and refrigerate.
  2. In a large skillet, add 2 tbsp of oil on med-high heat. Season salmon and cook for about 3 minutes on each side or until desired doneness is reached. Remove salmon from pan and set aside.
  3. Reduce heat to low and add margarine, garlic, mushrooms, half & half, and chicken stock to the same pan. Stir until sauce starts to simmer. Add asparagus and cover with a lid. Cook for about 10 minutes or until asparagus is tender. Season with salt/pepper to taste.
  4. Remove lid and add salmon back to the skillet. Spoon sauce over salmon and serve.
  5. OR
  6. Bake: Preheat oven to 400°F. Brush fillets lightly with melted butter or olive oil. Season as desired. Place fillets on a baking sheet with mixed veggies, bake for 15-17 minutes.
Split Lobster Tail Skewers Omaha Steakhouse
Ingredients
  • Do Not Thaw. Appliances vary, adjust cook times accordingly.
  • FOR FOOD SAFETY AND QUALITY, COOK THOROUGHLY TO A MINIMUM INTERNAL TEMPERATURE OF 165°F. AS INDICATED BY A FOOD THERMOMETER.
  • GRILL: Preheat grill to high. Grill skewers 4 minutes, shell side down. Reduce heat to medium. Grill 6 to 8 minutes, or until fully cooked.
  • OVEN: Preheat oven to 450°F. Place skewers on baking sheet, shell side down, in center of oven. Bake 12 to 14 minutes or until fully cooked.
Shell-On Wild Argentinian Red Shrimp Omaha Steakhouse
Ingredients
  • 1 lemon / juice
  • 2 tbsp minced garlic
  • 1 tsp Old Bay
  • 1/2 tsp pepper
  • 1/4 cup butter
Steps
  1. To thaw shrimp, pierce bag and place on baking sheet in refrigerator overnight.
  2. Quick Thaw Method: Place shrimp in a bowl of cold water for 30 minutes.
  3. Take off shell and devein. Cut along the top side with a sharp knife from the head to the tail. Clean and rinse out any debris.
  4. Combine lemon juice, garlic, Old Bay, and pepper and pour over shrimp in a 9x13” pan. Place butter squares around shrimp. Bake 14 minutes at 425 degrees.
Redhook® Ale Beer-Battered Shrimp Omaha Steakhouse
Steps
  1. Do not thaw. Keep frozen until ready to cook. Appliances vary, adjust cook time accordingly.
  2. FOR FOOD SAFETY AND QUALITY, FOLLOW THESE COOKING INSTRUCTIONS. FOOD MUST BE COOKED TO AN INTERNAL TEMPERATURE OF 165°F AS INDICATED BY A FOOD THERMOMETER.
  3. Oven: Preheat oven to 425°F. Place shrimp in a single layer on lined baking sheet. Bake 11-13 minutes, turning shrimp over halfway through baking time for best results. Bake until shrimp reach an internal temperature of 165°F.
  4. Air Fryer: Preheat air fryer to 400°F. Place desired number of shrimps in fry basket. Bake for 6-8 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 165°F, shaking basket half way through cooking time.
Pub-Style Cod Omaha Steakhouse
Steps
  1. Do not thaw.
  2. OVEN: Preheat oven to 425°F. Place cod portions in a single layer in shallow baking pan. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes. Turn half way through cooking time.
Bacon-Wrapped Scallops Omaha Steakhouse
Ingredients
  • From frozen -- Oven: Preheat oven to 375°F. Remove scallops from tray. Place individual bacon wrapped scallops on a foil-lined baking sheet allowing 1 inch or more between pieces. Bake uncovered for 14 - 16 minutes.
  • From Thawed: Thaw in refrigerator. When thawing, remove from plastic packaging. Cover and refrigerate below 38°F. Once thawed, consume within one to two days.
  • Oven: Preheat oven to 375°F. Remove scallops from tray. Place individual bacon wrapped scallops on a foil-lined baking sheet allowing 1 inch or more between pieces. Bake uncovered for 8-10 minutes.
  • Cook to a minimum internal temperature of 165°F.
Yellowfin Tuna Steaks Omaha Steakhouse
Ingredients
  • 1 tbsp black pepper
  • 2 tbsp teriyaki sauce
  • 2 tbsp lemon or lime juice
  • 4 tsp olive oil
  • 1 broccoli head
  • 4 medium tuna steaks
  • 1/4 cup chicken broth
  • 1/4 cup dry white wine
Steps
  1. Thaw in Refrigerator. Remove from plastic packaging.
  2. Combine the pepper, teriyaki sauce, and juice. Place tuna in bowl, cover and refrigerate overnight.
  3. In a large skillet, combine the peppercorn mixture, broth, and wine, cook over high heat until the sauce is light brown.
  4. Oven: Preheat oven to 400°F. Brush steaks lightly with melted butter or olive oil. Season as desired. Place tuna steaks on baking sheet on middle rack of oven. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until opaque throughout.
  5. Reduce the heat to low, remove the tuna from the oven, and lay the steaks in the skillet. Sauté each side for 1 minutes. Pour the remaining sauce over the steaks.
  6. Pan Sauté: Preheat 1 tsp of olive oil per portion in a sauté pan over medium heat. Season as desired. Place steaks in pan and cook for 4-5 minutes. Flip, and continue to cook for 3-4 minutes.
Mahi Mahi Omaha Steakhouse
Ingredients
  • 1 tbsp butter
  • 1 tsp lemon juice
Steps
  1. Thaw in refrigerator. When thawing, remove from plastic packaging. Cover and refrigerate below 38°F. Once thawed, consume within one to two days.
  2. Broil approximately 5-7 minutes per side. They are done when the steaks are opaque throughout. Baste with butter when cooking, if desired.
South Beach Salmon Tuna Kabobs
Adapted from https://www.food.com/recipe/south-beach-fish-kabobs-93018
Servings: 4
Ingredients
  • 1 1 lb salmon or 1 lb tuna steak , cut into 16 one inch thick cubes
  • 1 ⁄2 green pepper , cut into strips
  • 1 ⁄2 red pepper, cut into strips
  • olive oil
  • lime juice
  • dijon mustard
Steps
  1. Combine the olive oil, lime juice and dijon mustard in a small mixing bowl.
  2. Add fish cubes to the marinade, cover and place in refrigerator; marinate for 15 minutes turning once to coat.
  3. Meanwhile clean, core and cut your veggies.
  4. Thread skewers with veggies and fish, 4 pieces of fish per skewer, and brush kabobs with leftover marinade.
  5. Preheat broiler and place the kabobs on a broiler pan.
Ham & Rice Stuffed Peppers
Adapted from https://fricksqualitymeats.com/recipes/ham-rice-stuffed-peppers/
Servings: 6
Ingredients
  • 2 cups diced ham
  • 3 large sweet bell peppers
  • 1 clove garlic, minced
  • 1/4 cup low sodium chicken broth
  • 3 cups cooked, long-grain white rice
  • 3/4 cup shredded cheddar
  • 2 Tbsp. olive oil
  • 4 oz softened cream cheese
  • 4 Tbsp. green onion, finely chopped
  • 2 Tbsp. chives, chopped
  • 2 tsp. onion powder
  • Salt & pepper to taste
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 350°F.
  2. Cut peppers lengthwise and remove the stems and seeds. Lightly coat the peppers in olive oil (~1 Tbsp.). Place pepper halves cut face down on a baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes. Remove and let cool. Up oven heat to 400°F.
  3. Pour remaining olive oil into a skillet and heat over medium heat. Add garlic and chopped white stalks of green onion to skillet. Sauté until the onion begins to soften, about 2 minutes.
  4. Mix in chicken broth, ham & onion powder. Bring to a simmer, then keep at a low simmer for about 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add in cooked rice, cream cheese, salt, pepper, chives & chopped green stalks of green onion, then mix until well combined.
  5. Flip over peppers then spoon heaps of the mixture into the pepper halves to fill them. Sprinkle each filled pepper with the shredded cheddar, then bake for 5-7 min. Bake an additional 2 min. on a high broil setting to lightly brown the cheese. Enjoy warm.
One Pot Ham & Penne Skillet Recipe
Adapted from https://www.julieseatsandtreats.com/one-pot-ham-penne-skillet-recipe/
Ingredients
  • 1 Tbsp olive oil
  • 1/2 c. chopped yellow onion
  • 3 cloves minced garlic
  • 3 c. cubed fully cooked ham
  • 1/2 tsp dried parsley
  • 1/2 tsp dried basil
  • 1/4 tsp dried oregano
  • 1/4 tsp pepper
  • 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes
  • 3 c. chicken broth
  • 2 c. 2% milk
  • 1/4 c. flour
  • 16 oz penne noodles, uncooked
  • 2 c. frozen peas thawed
  • 1/2 c. Parmesan cheese
Steps
  1. Place 1 Tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat until warm. Saute ham and onions until onions are translucent. Add garlic, parsley, basil, oregano, pepper and red pepper flakes; cook 1-2 minutes.
  2. Stir in broth, milk, flour and penne noodles. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer 10-12 minutes, stirring frequently.
  3. Adds peas and simmer five more minutes or until pasta is cooked through and peas are warm.
  4. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese on top of pasta.
Ham Casserole with Broccoli and Rice
Adapted from https://thecozycook.com/ham-casserole/
Servings: 6
Ingredients
  • 2 Tablespoons unsalted butter
  • ½ cup yellow onion, finely diced
  • 1 Tablespoon olive oil
  • 2 1/2 cups chicken broth, low sodium
  • 1 ¼ cup white long grain rice, uncooked
  • 2 cups cooked ham, diced
  • 2 cups broccoli florets
  • 10.75 oz. cream of chicken soup
  • ½ cup sour cream
  • ¾ cup milk
  • 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese, separated
  • Salt/Pepper, optional
  • Ritz Cracker Topping
  • 1 cup Ritz Crackers, crushed into crumbs
  • 2 Tablespoons butter, melted
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
  2. Melt the 2 Tablespoons butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
  3. Add the diced onions and cook for 5 minutes, until softened.
  4. Add the chicken broth, olive oil, and rice to the pot and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
  5. Cover tightly and cook for 7 minutes.
  6. Add the broccoli, replace the cover, cook for 8 more minutes. Refrain from stirring.
  7. Turn off heat, leave the cover on. Let the rice stand for 10 minutes. Any rice on the bottom of the pot will release during this time.
  8. Add the diced ham, condensed soup, sour cream, milk, and ONE cup of the cheddar cheese. Stir until well-combined.
  9. Spread into a lightly greased 9 x 13 casserole dish.
  10. Top with remaining cup of cheddar cheese.
  11. Cover and bake for 15 minutes.
  12. Combine the Ritz cracker crumbs and butter. Spread over the top of the casserole and bake, uncovered, for 10 additional minutes.
Spinach Pizza
Ingredients
  • 1 1 pound refrigerated pizza crust dough (I like Trader Joe's garlic & herb dough for this one) or use your own favorite pizza dough
  • 24 medium cloves garlic (about 2 heads, separated, peel left on)
  • 1 tablespoon + 2 teaspoons olive oil + more for working the crust
  • 1 cup part-skim ricotta cheese (whole milk ricotta works too)
  • 2 tablespoons chopped fresh basil
  • 1 teaspoon honey
  • 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano
  • 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt + more for sprinkling the garlic
  • 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
  • 1 10-ounce bag frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed to remove any excess moisture
  • 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese (divided) (about 8 ounces)
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
  2. Drizzle a baking sheet with a little olive oil and place the pizza dough on top to rest.
  3. Lay out a large square of foil and place the garlic cloves on top (be sure you leave the peel on!). Drizzle with 1 tablespoon olive oil and sprinkle with a couple of pinches of kosher salt. Fold the foil into a sealed packet and place in the oven. Roast the garlic until soft, golden, and fragrant, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool. Once cool enough to handle, peel the cloves and discard the skins.
  4. Increase oven to 450°F.
  5. Add 8 of the peeled garlic cloves to a small bowl. Smash with a fork. Add the ricotta, 2 teaspoons olive oil, basil, honey, oregano, 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, and pepper. Mix well.
  6. Stretch the pizza crust and place on greased cookie sheet.
  7. Top the crust with tablespoon-sized mounts of ricotta. Scatter mozzarella cheese over the top.
  8. Scatter with spinach and remaining garlic cloves.
  9. Bake until the crust is crisp and golden and the cheese is melted and bubbling, 9-10 minutes.
Taco Bell Mexican Pizza
Ingredients
  • 1 pound ground beef
  • 1 packet taco seasoning
  • ¾ cup water
  • 1 cup vegetable oil
  • 8 flour tortillas (taco size)
  • 15 ounce can refried beans
  • 10 ounce can enchilada sauce
  • 2 cups shredded Mexican cheese blend
    • Toppings:
  • diced tomatoes
  • sliced green onion
  • sliced olives
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 400F. In a large skillet, brown and and crumble the ground beef. Add taco seasoning packet and water and stir. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer until thickened.
  2. In a large skillet, heat up oil over medium heat. Add tortillas (one at a time) and cook for 3-4 minutes (flipping frequently) until crisp. Continue with the rest of the tortillas. Set aside.
  3. Meanwhile, heat up the refried beans in a microwaveable-safe bowl. This will make it easier to spread the beans onto the tortilla shells.
  4. On each tortilla, slather a generous layer of refried beans. Then top with seasoned ground beef.
  5. Place another tortilla on top. Slather about two tablespoons of the enchilada sauce on top. Then place some shredded cheese on top of the sauce. Continue assembling the rest of the pizzas.
  6. Place the pizzas on a large nonstick baking sheet and bake for about 8-10 minutes until cheese is melted. Serve with your favoriet toppings
Taco Casserole
Ingredients
  • 1 lb Ground Beef
  • 1 Onion chopped
  • 1 can Corn
  • 1 can Black Beans drained and rinsed
  • 1 can Diced Tomatoes with Green Chilis
  • 4 tablespoons taco seasoning
  • 1 tsp Salt
  • 2 cups Cooked Rice
  • 1/2 cups Shredded Cheddar Cheese
Steps
  1. Cook ground beef. Add in chopped onions and cook until soft.
  2. Stir in Taco seasoning seasoning, corn, tomatoes and beans.
  3. Spray 2 9×13 pans with non stick spray. Spoon 2 cups of rice into the bottom of each pan, spreading it out evenly.
  4. Spoon the meat mixture over the rice.
  5. Top with the ½ of the cheese on each pan
  6. Bake covered at 350 degrees for about 25 minutes until cooked through
Apple-Walnut Chicken Salad
Ingredients
  • 5 oz chicken
  • 1/2 cup chopped celery
  • 3/4 cup chopped apple
  • 2 oz walnuts
  • 1/3 cup Italian dressing
  • Lettuce
Steps
  1. Stir together ingredients and serve on lettuce.
Salmon with cucumber-dill sauce
Ingredients
  • Salmon
  • 2 cups chablis (or dry white wine)
  • 2 cups water
  • 1⁄2 teaspoon chicken bouillon granule
  • 6 peppercorns
  • 4 sprigs fresh dill
  • 2 bay leaves
  • 1 celery rib, chopped
  • 1 small lemon, sliced
  • 6 (4 ounce) salmon fillets, 1/2-inch thick
  • Cucumber-Dill Sauce
  • 1⁄3 cup cucumber, peeled, seeded, finely chopped
  • 1⁄3 cup nonfat sour cream
  • 1⁄3 cup plain fat-free yogurt
  • 2 teaspoons fresh dill, chopped
  • 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard
  • fresh dill
Steps
  1. For the salmon: Combine the wine, water, bouillon, peppercorns, dillweed, bay leaves, celery, and lemon in a skillet. Bring to a boil; cover.
    2. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
    Add the salmon to the mixture in the skillet and cook for 10 minutes or until the fish flakes easily.
    To prepare Cucumber-Dill Sauce: In a medium bowl, mix together the cucumber, sour cream, yogurt, dill, and mustard.
    To serve: place the fillets on individual serving plates. Spoon the sauce evenly over the fillets. Garnish with fresh dill.
Black Bean & Corn Dip
Ingredients
  • 1 can corn
  • 1 can black beans drained & rinsed
  • 1 red bell pepper chopped small
  • ⅓ cup chopped cilantro
  • ½ cup zesty Italian dressing
  • 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice
  • 1 teaspoon kosher salt
  • 1 teaspoon garlic powder
  • 1 teaspoon cumin
Steps
  1. For best taste, cover the bowl with a lid or plastic wrap and let refrigerate for 4 hours before serving.
Beef veggie soup
Ingredients
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 1½ pounds 85% lean ground beef
  • 1 cup diced yellow onion
  • 1 teaspoon minced garlic
  • 2 teaspoons Italian seasoning
  • 1½ teaspoons salt
  • freshly ground black pepper, to taste
  • ¼ teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
  • 3 tablespoons tomato paste
  • 28 ounce can whole tomatoes, undrained
  • 5 cups low sodium-beef broth, divided
  • 2 large carrots, ½-inch slices
  • 2 celery ribs, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced
  • 1 pound baby potatoes, halved or quartered (like Little Potato Company)
  • 1 cup diced bell pepper, (I used a mixture of green and red)
  • ½ cup uncooked long grain white rice
  • 1 cup frozen peas, (no need to thaw)
  • ¼ cup chopped fresh parsley
Steps
  1. Add olive oil to a Dutch oven and place over MEDIUM heat. Add ground beef, onions, and garlic and cook, stirring to break up the beef until beef is crumbled and no longer pink. Drain well. Season with salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and cayenne. Add the tomato paste and stir well to combine. Add the tomatoes, 4 cups of the broth (reserve remaining amount for later), carrots, celery, potatoes, bell pepper, and rice.
  2. Bring the mixture to a boil then reduce heat to LOW, cover and simmer 30 minutes or until vegetables and rice are tender.
  3. Uncover and use the spoon to crush any remaining large pieces of tomato. Stir in the frozen peas and parsley. Allow the stew to simmer 10 minutes longer or until thickened to desired consistency. If the mixture is too thick, add as much of the remaining broth as desired.
Cocktail sauce
Ingredients
  • 1/2 cup of ketchup
  • 2 tablespoons horseradish
  • Worcestershire sauce
  • 1 lemon
  • Tabasco sauce, to taste
Dip
Ingredients
  • 1 red pepper
  • 2 jalapenos (unseeded)
  • 1 can of corn
  • 1/2 can diced olives
  • 16 oz fat-free cream cheese (softened)
  • 1 packet Hidden Valley Ranch dip seasoning mix
Steps
  1. Mix ingredients together. Serve with crackers or raw veggies.
General Tso’s Tofu with Quinoa (Purple Carrot Vegan)
Ingredients
  • ¾ cup quinoa
  • 1 oz fresh ginger, peeled and minced
  • 2 garlic cloves, peeled and minced
  • 2 tbsp tamari
  • 3 tbsp turbinado sugar
  • 1 tbsp rice vinegar
  • 10 oz organic extra firm tofu, patted dry and cut into 1-inch cubes
  • ¼ cup cornstarch
  • 1 tbsp tuxedo sesame seeds (divided)
  • 2 scallions, sliced into 2-inch pieces
  • 6 oz broccoli florets
  • 2 tbsp vegetable oil
  • Salt and pepper
Steps
  1. Bring a large pot with 2 inches salted water to a boil for the broccoli. In a small saucepan, combine quinoa, 1¼ cups water, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook until water is absorbed and grains are tender, 12 to 15 minutes. (4-serving meal: use 4 inches salted water, 2½ cups water)
  2. Add ginger, garlic, tamari, turbinado sugar, and rice vinegar to a medium bowl. Whisk the ginger garlic sauce to combine.
  3. Add tofu, cornstarch, just 2 tsp sesame seeds, and a pinch of salt and pepper to a large bowl and toss to coat the tofu. Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add coated tofu and cook, tossing occasionally, until crispy and browned in places, 5 to 8 minutes (adding more vegetable oil as needed).
  4. Add scallion to the skillet with tofu and cook, 1 to 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low, add ginger garlic sauce, and toss. Cook until sauce thickens, about 30 seconds.
  5. Add broccoli florets to the large pot of boiling water and cook until florets are tender and bright green, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and add a pinch of salt and pepper.
  6. Divide the quinoa and broccoli between large plates and top with General Tso’s tofu. Sprinkle with remaining sesame seeds.
Buffalo Cauliflower Quesadillas (Purple Carrot Vegan)
Ingredients
  • 6 oz cauliflower florets, cut into bite-size pieces
  • 1 tsp paprika powder
  • 4 tbsp hot sauce
  • 1 mango, peeled and diced
  • 1 lime, half juiced, half cut into wedges
  • 1 oz pickled jalapeños (divided)
  • 2 whole wheat flour tortillas
  • 2 oz Treeline® Dairy-Free Cream Cheese
  • 1 oz vegan mozzarella
  • ¼ cup vegan ranch dressing
  • 1 tbsp vegetable oil
  • Salt
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 400°F. Add cauliflower, 1 tsp vegetable oil, paprika, and just 2 tbsp hot sauce to a foil-lined baking sheet and toss. Bake until tender, 10 to 12 minutes.
  2. Add mango, lime juice, and just half the pickled jalapeño to a medium bowl. Toss the jalapeño mango salsa.
  3. Place tortillas on a flat surface. Spread cream cheese on half of each tortilla. Top with Buffalo cauliflower and mozzarella. Drizzle with remaining hot sauce, fold quesadillas, and gently press to seal.
  4. Heat 1 tsp vegetable oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add one quesadilla and cook until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Repeat to make the remaining quesadilla.
  5. Cut each Buffalo cauliflower quesadilla into three pieces. Serve with jalapeño mango salsa, lime wedges on the side, and ranch dressing for dipping.
Thin Mint Cookies
Ingredients
  • 3/4 cup (172g) unsalted butter, softened to room temperature
  • 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar
  • 1 large egg, at room temperature
  • 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
  • 1/4 teaspoon peppermint extract*
  • 1 and 1/2 cups (188g) all-purpose flour (spoon & leveled)
  • 3/4 cup (62g) unsweetened natural cocoa powder (or dutch process)
  • 1 teaspoon baking powder
  • 1/8 teaspoon salt
  • Topping
  • 14 ounces (395g) quality semi-sweet chocolate, coarsely chopped
  • 1/2 teaspoon canola or vegetable oil
  • 1/4 teaspoon peppermint extract
Steps
  1. Make the cookies: In a large bowl using a hand-held mixer or stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat the butter for 1 minute on medium speed until completely smooth and creamy. Add the granulated sugar and beat on medium high speed until fluffy and light in color. Beat in the egg, vanilla extract, and peppermint extract on high speed. Scrape down the sides and bottom of the bowl as needed.
    2. Sift the flour and cocoa powder together in a medium bowl. Whisk in the baking powder and salt until combined. On low speed, slowly mix into the wet ingredients until combined.
    Divide the dough into 2 equal parts. Roll each portion out onto a piece of parchment to about 1/4″ thickness. Stack the pieces (with parchment paper between) onto a baking sheet and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Chilling is mandatory. If chilling for more than a couple hours, cover the top dough piece with a single piece of parchment paper. You can chill up to 2 days.
  2. Once chilled, preheat oven to 350°F (177°C). Line 2-3 large baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats. Remove one of the dough pieces from the refrigerator and using a 2-inch round cookie cutter, cut in circles. Transfer the cut cookie dough to the prepared baking sheet. Re-roll the remaining dough and continue cutting until all is used.
    3. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the edges appear set. The cookies will seem very soft in the centers. Make sure you rotate the baking sheet halfway through bake time. Cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before dipping in chocolate.
    Once the cookies are cool, begin the topping: Melt the chopped chocolate and oil together in a double boiler or (carefully!) use the microwave. For the microwave, place the chocolate and oil in a medium heat-proof bowl. Melt in 15 second increments, stirring after each increment until completely melted and smooth. Once melted, stir in the peppermint extract. Dip each cooled cookie completely into the chocolate and use a fork to lift out. Tap the fork gently on the side of the bowl to allow excess chocolate to drip off. Place cookie onto a parchment or silicone baking mat-lined baking sheet. Place the baking sheet into the refrigerator to help the chocolate set. Once set, enjoy!
    Cover and store leftover cookies at room temperature for up to 2-3 days or in the refrigerator for up to 1 week. The cookies taste delicious cold. I love eaten straight from the freezer!
Roasted Peppers & Herb Vinaigrette Bowls (Purple Carrot Vegan)
Ingredients
  • 1 lemon, juiced
  • 1 tsp agave
  • 2 tsp Dijon mustard
  • 8.8 oz brown rice
  • 13.4 oz cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
  • 1 shallot, peeled and minced
  • 1 oz fresh parsley, leaves and tender stems roughly chopped
  • 4 oz roasted red peppers, drained
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • Salt and pepper
Steps
  1. Add rice & beans to IP and cover with water and salt. Pressure cook for 5 minutes.
  2. Add lemon juice, agave, Dijon mustard, 1 tbsp olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper to a small bowl and whisk the herb vinaigrette.
  3. Combine ingredients & divide between bowls.
White Bean Cassoulet (Purple Carrot Vegan)
Ingredients
  • 2 carrots, peeled and sliced into rounds
  • 8 oz cremini mushrooms, halved
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1 celery stalk, thinly sliced
  • 1 onion, peeled and diced
  • ¼ oz fresh tarragon, leaves picked from the stems
  • 2 garlic cloves, peeled and minced
  • 13.4 oz cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
  • 1 Not-Chick’n™ Bouillon Cube
  • 3 tbsp vegan parmesan
  • 1 lemon, half juiced, half cut into wedges
  • 2 oz baby arugula
  • 2 tbsp vegan basil pesto
  • 3 tbsp olive oil
  • Salt and pepper
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 400°F. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. Add carrot, celery, onion, garlic, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Cook vegetables until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
  2. Add cannellini beans, bouillon cube, and ½ cup water to the saucepan and stir until bouillon cube dissolves, 1 to 2 minutes. Transfer mixture to a baking dish and top with parmesan. Bake the white bean cassoulet until lightly browned, 18 to 24 minutes.
  3. Return the saucepan to medium-high heat with 2 tbsp olive oil. Add cremini mushrooms and cook until well browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Add paprika and ¼ tsp salt, toss, and remove from heat.
  4. Add tarragon leaves, just 2 tsp lemon juice, arugula, and a pinch of salt and pepper to a large bowl and toss. Drizzle basil pesto over the white bean cassoulet. Serve the cassoulet family-style with smoky cremini mushrooms, herb salad, and lemon wedges on the side.
Maple-Chipotle Carrot Tacos (Purple Carrot Vegan)
Ingredients
  • 6 carrots, peeled and quartered lengthwise
  • 1 tbsp maple syrup
  • 1 oz chipotle pepper in adobo, roughly chopped
  • ¼ cup pumpkin seeds
  • 13.4 oz black beans, drained and rinsed
  • 6 corn tortillas
  • 1 avocado, halved and diced
  • 1 lime, cut into wedges
  • Salt and pepper
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
    • 3 oz Mojo Verde sauce:
  • 1 large bunch Cilantro
  • 4 large cloves Garlic
  • 2 tbsp lime juice
  • ½ tsp Cumin
  • 1 Jalapeno
  • 1 tbsp White Wine Vinegar
  • ½ cup Olive Oil
  • Salt
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 450°F. Add carrots,1 tbsp olive oil, maple syrup, just half the chipotle in adobo, and a pinch of salt to a baking sheet and toss. Roast until carrots are lightly browned at the edges, 10 to 12 minutes.
  2. Sprinkle pumpkin seeds over the carrots. Return the baking sheet to the oven and cook until the seeds are lightly browned and crispy, about 5 minutes. TIP: Leave the oven on for your tortillas.
  3. Add Mojo Verde and black beans to a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook until heated through, 3 to 4 minutes. Using the back of a fork, smash about half the beans and stir until incorporated with remaining whole beans. Wrap tortillas in foil and place in oven to warm, 4 to 5 minutes. TIP: You can wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and use a microwave instead if you prefer
  4. Divide warm tortillas between plates and top with Mojo Verde black beans, maple-chipotle carrots, and spicy pepitas. Finish with avocado and lime juice.
Miso Coconut Ramen Bowls (Purple Carrot Vegan)
Ingredients
  • 2 tbsp white miso paste
  • 5.5 oz coconut milk
  • 1 tbsp tamari
  • 1 oz ginger, sliced into rounds
  • 8 oz broccolini, chopped into 2-inch pieces
  • 2 oz teen spinach • 10 oz fresh ramen noodles
  • 1 lemon, half juiced, half cut into wedges
  • 2 tbsp chili garlic sauce
  • 1 tsp vegetable oil
Steps
  1. Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to a boil for the ramen. In a separate medium saucepan, combine white miso paste, coconut milk, tamari, 3 cups water, and a pinch of salt. Bring miso coconut broth to a boil over medium-high heat and whisk to dissolve miso paste. Add ginger, reduce heat to low, and let broth simmer.
  2. Move oven rack to top and set oven to broil on high. Add broccolini, 1 tsp vegetable oil, and a pinch of salt to a baking sheet and toss. Broil broccolini until tender and beginning to brown, 5 to 8 minutes.
  3. Add spinach to the miso coconut broth and stir. Simmer until just wilted, 3 to 5 minutes.
  4. Add fresh ramen noodles to boiling water and cook until just al dente, 1 to 2 minutes. Drain noodles and run under cool water to stop the cooking process.
  5. Add lemon juice to the miso coconut broth. Taste broth and add salt as needed. Divide ramen noodles between bowls. Top with miso coconut broth, charred broccolini, and chili garlic sauce. Serve with lemon wedges.
Alfredo with Spinach & Artichokes (Purple Carrot Vegan)
Ingredients
  • 13.75 oz artichoke hearts, drained and patted dry
  • 2 garlic cloves, minced
  • ¼ cup panko breadcrumbs
  • 6 oz mafaldine pasta
  • ¼ cup Treeline® Dairy-Free Herb Garlic Cheese
  • 4 oz teen spinach
  • 2 tbsp vegan basil pesto
  • 1 tbsp olive oil*
  • Salt and pepper
Steps
  1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add artichoke hearts and cook, undisturbed, until they start to brown, 3 to 4 minutes. Gently stir and add garlic and breadcrumbs. Continue to cook until garlic is fragrant and breadcrumbs are golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. (4-serving meal: use 2 tbsp olive oil)
  2. Once water is boiling, add pasta, stir, and cook until al dente, 8 to 10 minutes. Reserve ¼ cup pasta water and drain the pasta. Return cooked pasta and reserved pasta water to the pot. Add cashew cheese, spinach, and a pinch of salt and pepper and stir over low heat to combine. (4-serving meal: use ½ cup pasta water)
  3. Divide the mafaldine alfredo with spinach between bowls. Top with artichoke breadcrumbs and dollop with pesto.
Veggie Burger with Rice (Purple Carrot Vegan)
Ingredients
  • ¾ cup white basmati rice
  • 2 tsp curry powder (divided)
  • 2 Actual Veggies® Green Burgers
  • 1 oz Forager Project® Organic Dairy-free Cashewmilk Yogurt
  • 1 lemon, zested and juiced
  • 2 oz teen spinach
  • 4 oz Indian Butter sauce
  • ½ oz fresh cilantro, leaves picked from stems
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • Salt and pepper
Steps
  1. Add basmati rice, 1¼ cups water, and a pinch of salt to a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook until water is absorbed and rice is tender, 13 to 15 minutes. (4-serving meal: use 2½ cups water)
  2. Add 2 tsp olive oil to a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Sprinkle just half the madras curry powder on both sides of the veggie burgers. Add veggie burgers to the pan and cook until golden brown, 5 to 6 minutes per side. Remove from pan and cover to keep warm. (4-serving meal: use 4 tsp olive oil) TIP: The spinach will cook in the same pan.
  3. Combine yogurt, lemon zest, lemon juice, cilantro, and a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl and set aside. Return the skillet to medium heat with 1 tsp olive oil. Add spinach, remaining madras curry, and a pinch of salt and pepper and stir. Cook until spinach is wilted, 2 to 3 minutes. (4-serving meal: use 2 tsp olive oil)
  4. Add Indian Butter sauce to the skillet with the spinach and cook until heated through, 1 to 2 minutes. Divide basmati rice and Indian Butter sauce with spinach between two shallow bowls. Top with aloo tikki style patty and cilantro raita.
Chickpea Sandwiches w/Vegetables (Purple Carrot Vegan)
Ingredients
  • 3 mini sweet peppers, halved, trimmed, and deseeded
  • 1 red onion, peeled and cut into ½-inch thick rings
  • 2 Roma tomatoes, quartered
  • 2 garlic cloves, peeled and minced
  • 13.4 oz chickpeas, drained and rinsed
  • 3 oz Romesco sauce
  • 1 oz vegan mayo
  • 1 lemon, zested and juiced
  • 2 oz baby arugula
  • 2 ciabatta breads, sliced in half
  • 3 tsp olive oil
  • Salt and pepper
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 450°F. Add pepper, onion, tomato, 2 tsp olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper to a baking sheet and toss. Roast in the oven until vegetables are soft and beginning to brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Add just half the garlic to the roasted vegetables and return to the oven until garlic is fragrant, 3 to 5 minutes.
  2. Add chickpeas to a medium bowl and season with salt and pepper. Using a fork, mash the chickpeas just until they start to stick together and become creamy. Add mayo, lemon zest, just half the lemon juice, and just half the Romesco sauce and mix well.
  3. Turn the oven to broil, place the ciabatta, cut side up, directly on the top rack of the oven, and toast for 1 to 2 minutes. Add arugula to a medium bowl and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add remaining lemon juice, remaining garlic, and 1 tsp olive oil and toss to dress the arugula. (4-serving meal: use 2 tsp olive oil) TIP: All broilers are different. Watch carefully to ensure the ciabatta and chickpeas don’t burn.
  4. Spread remaining Romesco on the bottom halves of the ciabatta. Divide the smashed chickpeas between sandwiches. Put halves with chickpeas back under the broiler for 1 minute to warm the chickpeas. Top with roasted peppers, tomatoes, onions, and arugula. Close the sandwiches and serve with remaining arugula on the side.
Veggie Burgers & Fries Purple Carrot Favorite
Ingredients
  • 1 russet potato, cut into 6 wedges
  • ¼ cup vegan mayo
  • 1 tsp curry powder
  • 1 garlic clove, minced
  • 2 pretzel buns
  • 2 Actual Veggies® Orange Burgers
  • 2 oz baby arugula
  • 2 oz pickled jalapeños
  • 2 tbsp + 2 tsp olive oil
  • Salt and pepper
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 425°F. Add potato, 1 tbsp olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper to a foil-lined baking sheet and roast until golden brown, 25 to 30 minutes. Add mayo, curry powder, garlic, and a pinch of salt to a small bowl and stir to combine.
  2. Add 2 tsp olive oil to a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add pretzel buns, cut side down, and cook until buns are golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to serving plates. TIPS: If you’re making the 4-serving meal, toast the buns in batches and add more oil as needed. You can also toast the buns in a toaster oven or oven if you prefer.
  3. Wipe the skillet clean and return to medium-high heat with 1 tbsp olive oil. Add veggie burgers and cook until golden brown, 5 to 6 minutes per side. (4-serving meal: use 2 tbsp olive oil)
  4. Add arugula, just half the pickled jalapeños, and a pinch of salt to a medium bowl and toss. TIP: You can also place ingredients directly on your cutting board and toss.
  5. Spread the curry mayo on the bottom half of each bun. Add veggie burgers and arugula, and top with the remaining bun halves. Serve with fries and remaining pickled jalapeños.
Cheesy Potato Casserole
Adapted from https://www.pillsbury.com/recipes/cheesy-potato-casserole/30357dc0-fead-4289-b46b-7a72d8c862d4
Servings: 8
Ingredients
  • 1 pint (2 cups) sour cream
  • 1 can (10 3/4 oz) condensed cream of chicken soup
  • 1/2 cup butter, melted
  • 1 tablespoon garlic salt
  • 1 cup chopped onions
  • 1 bag (30 oz) frozen country-style shredded hash brown potatoes, partially thawed
  • 2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese (8 oz)
Steps
  1. Heat oven to 350°F.
  2. In large bowl, combine 1 pint (2 cups) sour cream, 1 can (10 3/4 oz) condensed cream of chicken soup, 1/2 cup melted butter, 1 tablespoon garlic salt, 1 cup chopped onions, 1 bag (30 oz) frozen country-style shredded hash brown potatoes, partially thawed, and 2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese (8 oz); stir until well blended.
  3. Pour into ungreased 13x9-inch (3-quart) glass baking dish.
  4. Bake 45 minutes.
Notes
  • Make up the recipe the night before serving, cover well, and refrigerate. Remove from refrigerator, uncover and let stand 30 minutes before baking. Bake as directed and move on to prepare other more last-minute menu items.
  • Mix up the creamy potatoes and spoon them into a large slow cooker. Cook them on LOW for 4 to 5 hours, stirring occasionally. Transport them to a potluck or set them out on a buffet for a brunch.
Sesame Orange Tofu (Purple Carrot Vegan)
Adapted from https://www.purplecarrot.com/recipe/sesame-orange-tofu-with-roasted-green-beans-sticky-rice
Ingredients
  • ½ cup quinoa speckled rice
  • 2 garlic cloves, minced
  • 1 navel orange, half juiced, half cut into wedges (divided)
  • 2 tbsp tamari
  • 2 tbsp turbinado sugar
  • 1 tbsp Sriracha
  • 6 oz green beans
  • 10 oz organic extra firm tofu, patted dry and cut into 1-inch pieces
  • 3 tbsp cornstarch
  • 1 tbsp white sesame seeds (divided)
  • 2 tbsp sesame oil
  • 2 scallions, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces
  • 1 tsp vegetable oil
  • Salt and pepper
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 425°F. Add quinoa speckled rice, 1 cup water, and a pinch of salt to a small saucepan. Bring to a boil, cover, reduce heat to low, and cook until grains are tender and water is absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes.
  2. Add garlic, orange juice, tamari, turbinado sugar, and Sriracha to a medium bowl. Whisk the orange sauce.
  3. Add green beans, 1 tsp vegetable oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper to a baking sheet and toss. Roast until tender and browned in places, 6 to 8 minutes.
  4. Add tofu, cornstarch, just 2 tsp sesame seeds, and a pinch of salt and pepper to a large bowl and toss to coat the tofu. Heat sesame oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add coated tofu and cook, tossing occasionally, until crispy and browned in places, 5 to 8 minutes.
  5. Add scallion to the skillet with tofu and cook, 1 to 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low and add the orange sauce. Toss to coat and cook until sauce thickens, about 30 seconds.
  6. Divide the sticky rice and roasted green beans between large plates and top with sesame orange tofu. Sprinkle with remaining sesame seeds and serve with orange wedges.
Italian Sausage Sandwiches (Purple Carrot)
Adapted from https://www.purplecarrot.com/recipe/italian-sausage-sandwiches-with-shallot-relish-dilly-cucumber-salad?plan=chefs_choice
Ingredients
  • 1 cucumber, thinly sliced
  • 5 garlic cloves, peeled, 4 thinly sliced and 1 minced (divided)
  • ¼ cup white vinegar
  • ½ tsp dried dill
  • 1 tsp turbinado sugar
  • 2 shallots, peeled and quartered
  • 1 oz balsamic glaze
  • 1½ tsp agave
  • 1 oz Follow Your Heart® Soy-Free Vegenaise®
  • 2 Field Roast® Italian sausages, sliced (plastic casing removed)
  • 2 ciabatta rolls
  • 2 oz baby arugula
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • Salt
Steps
  1. Set the oven to broil and position rack in the middle of the oven.
  2. Add cucumber, sliced garlic, white vinegar, dill, turbinado sugar, and a pinch of salt to a large bowl, and toss the dilly cucumber salad to combine. TIP: Continue to toss the cucumbers occasionally to ensure they are evenly coated.
  3. Add shallot, 2 tsp olive oil, and a pinch of salt to a baking sheet, and toss. Broil until softened and well-browned in places, 7 to 10 minutes. Let broiled shallots cool for 5 minutes, transfer to a cutting board, and roughly chop into bite-size pieces. In a medium bowl, combine chopped shallot, as much chile as you’d like, balsamic glaze, and agave. Toss the shallot relish and sprinkle with salt.
  4. Stir minced garlic, mayo, and a pinch of salt to a small bowl.
  5. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add sausages and cook until browned on both sides, 4 to 6 minutes. Slice ciabatta rolls in half, drizzle cut sides with 1 tsp olive oil, and sprinkle with salt. Broil in the oven, directly on the rack, until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes.
  6. Spread garlic aioli on half of each toasted ciabatta roll. Top with sausage, shallot relish, and baby arugula. Serve the Italian sausage sandwiches with dilly cucumber salad.
Black Bean Burgers with Sriracha Aioli
Adapted from https://www.myrecipes.com/recipe/black-bean-burgers-0
Servings: 4 (serving size: 1 burger)
Ingredients
  • 1 (15-ounce) can unsalted black beans, rinsed and drained
  • ¼ cup chopped onion
  • ¼ cup chopped fresh cilantro
  • 1 tablespoon minced garlic
  • 2 teaspoons lower-sodium soy sauce
  • ½ teaspoon kosher salt
  • ¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
  • ¼ cup panko (Japanese breadcrumbs)
  • 1 large egg, lightly beaten
  • Cooking spray
  • 4 (1 1/2-ounce) hamburger buns
  • ¼ cup canola mayonnaise
  • 1 teaspoon Sriracha (hot chile sauce)
  • 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice
  • 2 cups baby arugula
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 425°.
  2. Place beans in a large bowl; lightly mash. Stir in onion and next 7 ingredients. Divide mixture into 4 portions; shape each into a 1/2-inch-thick patty.
  3. Arrange patties on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray. Bake at 425° for 8 minutes; turn after 6 minutes. Add bun halves to pan; bake 3 minutes.
  4. Combine mayonnaise, Sriracha, and juice; spread over bottom halves of buns. Top each serving with 1 patty, 1/2 cup arugula, and top halves of buns.
Jalapeño Avocado Cream Cheese Wontons
Adapted from https://www.cakenknife.com/jalapeno-avocado-cream-cheese-wontons/
Servings: 30 Wontons
Ingredients
  • 8 oz cream cheese, room temperature
  • 2/3 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
  • 2/3 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
  • 1 avocado, peeled and pitted, mashed or cubed
  • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • 1/2 tsp onion powder
  • 1/4 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp chopped cilantro
  • 3 jalapeños, seeded and diced
  • 1 package wonton wrappers
  • Canola Oil
  • Optional: hot honey (or plain honey)
Steps
  1. In a medium bowl, stir together cream cheese, cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, avocado, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, cilantro and jalapeños.
  2. On a clean work surface, lay out a wonton wrapper so a corner is pointed towards you (making it look like a diamond).
  3. Moisten the edges of the wrappers with water. Add 1 tsp of the filling in the center of the wonton wrapper.
  4. Fold the wrapper in half, over the filling. Start by pressing around the filling gently and pressing out towards the edges to seal. You want to make sure there are no air pockets by the filling so it seals properly. Repeat with the remaining filling and wonton wrappers.
  5. Heat 1 to 2 inches of canola oil in a heavy-bottomed large pot. Once the oil reaches 375°F on an oil thermometer (or the oil starts popping), fry the wontons in batches of 3 to 4 at a time.
  6. Fry until golden brown, approximately 1 minute per side. Remove to a paper towel lined plate to drain.
  7. Serve hot with a drizzle of hot honey!
Notes
  • How to Bake: Lightly grease a baking sheet and preheat oven to 375 degrees. Then once the wontons are made, add them to the baking sheet and lightly spray the tops with cooking spray. Bake for about 10 to 15 minutes, until golden brown!
  • How to Air Fry: Set the air fryer to 380˚F and cook for 10 minutes, flipping halfway through. Don’t forget to spray the basket/insert so the wontons don’t stick!
Egg Rolls Air Fryer
Ingredients
  • 6 egg roll wrappers
  • 3 cups cabbage shredded
  • 1/4 cup shredded carrot
  • 1.5 tsp toasted sesame oil
  • 2 tsp ginger grated
  • 1 clove garlic {minced}
  • 1 tsp reduced sodium soy sauce
  • 1/4 tsp black pepper
  • 2 green onions sliced
  • 1 tsp olive oil
Steps
  1. Preheat a frying pan for a few minutes over medium heat.
    2. Add the sesame oil, ginger, garlic, cabbage, and shredded carrot. Cook down for 2-3 minutes or until the cabbage has wilted.
    Add the green onions, soy sauce, and black pepper. Stir and remove from heat.
    Assemble your egg rolls. Brush olive oil over the top of the egg rolls & the basket of your air fryer. Place the egg rolls in the basket, seam side down, without letting them touch each other.
    Bake at 360 degrees F for 7 minutes. Flip and bake for an additional 2 minutes.
Reuben sauce
Ingredients
  • 1/4 cup mayo
  • 1 1/2 tsp chili garlic sauce
  • 1/2 tsp lemon juice
  • 1 ½ tsp creamy horseradish
  • 1 garlic clove, minced
  • ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce
  • 1/2 Tbsp onion, finely grated
  • ⅛ tsp paprika
  • Salt and pepper, to taste
Philly Cheese Steak Casserole
Ingredients
  • 1 ½ lb. Ground beef
  • 2 Bell peppers chopped
  • 1 Onion chopped
  • 2 tbsp Minced garlic
  • 1 tbsp Seasoned salt
  • 1 tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 tsp pepper
  • 8 Slices provolone cheese
  • 4 Large Eggs
  • ¼ C. Heavy whipping cream
  • 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
  • 4 Ciabatta or sub rolls
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
  2. In a skillet over medium high heat on the stove, begin to brown the meat. When the meat is partially browned, add the onions and peppers to the skillet. Cook until the meat is completely browned and the vegetables are beginning to soften.
  3. Add the seasonings and garlic to the skillet and saute another 30 seconds.
  4. Layer the beef in the bottom of a well greased 9×13 baking dish.
  5. Top the beef with the cheese slices.
    6. Mix together the heavy whipping cream, Worcestershire sauce and eggs in a bowl, and pour over the meat mixture in the baking dish.
  6. Bake for 30 minutes. Turn off oven. Place rolls in oven to toast for a few minutes (spray with Pam) while the casserole finishes cooking.
Subway Bread
Ingredients
  • 1 cup warm water (110 degrees F)
  • 1 tablespoon instant yeast
  • 1 tablespoon sugar
  • 1 ½ teaspoon salt
  • 4 tablespoons olive oil
  • 2 ½ to 2 ¾ cups all-purpose flour
Steps
  1. In the bowl of your stand mixer, add the water, yeast, sugar, salt, and olive oil. Let the mixture stand for 5 minutes.
    2. Add 1 cup of flour and mix with the dough hook for 3 to 5 minutes. Add an additional cup of flour and mix until well combined. Continue adding the flour, ¼ cup at a time, until a soft dough is formed. The dough should still stick to the bottom of of the bowl, but pull away from the sides. Let the dough mix for around 8 minutes total.
    When the dough has come together but is still sticking a bit to the bottom of the bowl, turn it out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth. The dough should be very soft. Shape the dough into a ball and return it to the bowl. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and allow the dough to rise for a half hour.
    After the dough has risen, turn it out onto a clean surface and divide it into 4. Roll each piece of dough into a long skinny loaf that is about 9 to 10 inches long.
    Place the rolled loaves onto a baking sheet lined with parchment or a baking mat. Repeat with the rest of the dough. Allow at least 2 inches between each loaf on the pan.
    Cover the loaves with a greased piece of plastic wrap and allow the loaves to rise until doubled, about an hour.
    Towards the end of the rising time, preheat the oven to 350 degrees. When the loaves are ready, bake them in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
    When the loaves come out of the oven, rub the tops with a stick of butter and cover them with a dish towel to cool.
    Let the loaves cool for at least 30 minutes before cutting down the middle.
Cream of Chicken Soup
Adapted from https://thecozycook.com/cream-of-chicken-soup-recipe/
Servings: 2 CANS
Ingredients
  • 4 Tablespoons Butter
  • ½ cup + 2 Tablespoons Flour
  • 2 cups Chicken Broth
  • 1 chicken bouillon cube
  • 1 cup milk, preferably whole
  • 1/3 teaspoon celery salt
  • 1/3 teaspoon onion powder
  • 1/3 teaspoon garlic powder
  • 1/3 teaspoon salt
  • 1/3 teaspoon pepper
Steps
  1. Note: It’s important to whisk continuously throughout this process to ensure the smoothest possible consistency.
  2. Temper the milk by microwaving it for 45 seconds. This prevents curdling but also prevents lumps from forming when it’s added. Set aside.
  3. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Let it fully melt and wait until it starts to foam, about 3 minutes.
  4. Gradually add the flour, whisk continuously for 3-5 minutes, until it’s the consistency of wet sand. Remove from the heat.
  5. Add 1/3 of the chicken broth and whisk well. Add 1/3 more, whisk well.
  6. Add the remaining chicken broth, chicken bouillon, warm milk, and seasonings, whisk continuously.
  7. Turn up to medium-high heat, continue to whisk until it begins to get very thick. Immediately remove from heat.
  8. Soup will continue to thicken upon standing.
Blond Puttanesca Purple Carrot
Ingredients
  • 3 tbsp olive oil
  • Salt and pepper
  • 3 garlic cloves, thinly sliced
  • 4 oz kale, chopped
  • 13.4 oz chickpeas, drained and rinsed
  • 1 tsp dried oregano
  • ¼ tsp red chile flakes
  • 6 oz gluten-free penne pasta
  • 1 oz vegan oat butter
  • 1 lemon, zested and juiced
  • 2 tbsp vegan parmesan
    • 2 oz chopped Olive Tapenade:
  • 3 cloves garlic
  • 1 cup Kalamata Olives (pitted)
  • Fresh Parsley (chopped)
  • 2 tablespoons Capers
  • 2 tablespoons Lemon Juice
  • 2 tablespoons Olive Oil
Steps
  1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 2 to 3 minutes. Add kale, chickpeas, oregano, and as much of the red chile flakes as you’d like, and cook until kale wilts, 1 to 2 minutes.
  2. Add penne to the boiling water and cook until al dente, 10 to 12 minutes. Reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain the pasta. Return cooked pasta to the pot and toss with butter to prevent sticking.
  3. Add reserved pasta water, 2 tbsp olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper to the skillet with the chickpeas. Cook until liquid reduces slightly, 3 to 5 minutes. Add penne and toss. Add lemon zest, just 1 tbsp lemon juice, parmesan, tapenade, and stir. Taste, and add salt and pepper as needed
  4. Divide the blond puttanesca with chickpeas and lemon olive sauce between large plates.
Butterball turkey with sides
Ingredients
    Turkey:
  • 1 tsp Salt
  • 1 tsp Pepper
  • 1 tsp Paprika
  • 1 tsp Garlic powder
  • 1 tsp Onion powder
  • 1 tsp Greek seasoning
  • 1 tsp Garlic & Herb seasoning
  • 2 tbsp butter cut in half
    • Sides:
  • Ore-Ida Homestyle Steam 'N' Mash Recipe Ready Pre-Cut Russet Potatoes Frozen Side Dish, 24 oz Bag (follow directions on bag to cook)
  • 1 can corn
  • 1 French Baguette
Steps
    Turkey:
  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the turkey in a 9x9” glass pan. Smother with seasonings and butter.
    2. Bake 1 1/2 hours.
Sweet Potato Black Bean Pitas
Adapted from http://www.godsavethequinoa.com/roasted-sweet-potato-black-bean-pitas/
Servings: 6
Ingredients
  • 2 sweet potatoes, peeled and diced
  • 2 jalapenos, diced
  • 1 red bell pepper, diced
  • 1 red onion, diced
  • 2 Tbs olive oil
  • 2 tsp cumin
  • 2 tsp chili powder
  • 1 tsp paprika
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 1 (15 oz) can black beans, drained
  • 1/2 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
  • Juice of 1 lime
  • 2 cups of baby kale or baby spinach
  • 1/2 cup goat cheese crumbles
  • Whole wheat pita pocket halves
Steps
  1. Pre-heat oven to 425 degrees. Combine veggies with olive oil and spices and bake for 20 minutes.
  2. Reduce oven temperature to 375 degrees.
  3. Mix cilantro, black beans, and lime juice to roasted veggies.
  4. Lightly spray PAM on the outside of the pita and add kale, cheese, & veggie mix
  5. Wrap with foil and bake 15 minutes.
Loaded Black Bean & Rice Bowls Every Plate
Ingredients
  • 1 Roma Tomato, diced
  • 1/2 Red Onion, finely chopped
  • Bunch of Cilantro, finely chopped
  • 1/4 cup diced Jalapeño
  • 2 tbsp White Wine Vinegar
  • 2 cups Rice
  • 1 can Black Beans (not rinsed)
  • Southwest Spice/Fajita seasoning
  • 1 avocado or prepared Guacamole
  • 1/2 cup Shredded Cheese
  • Crispy Fried Onions
  • Lime
  • 1/4 tsp sugar
  • 1 tbsp water
  • 1 tbsp butter
  • Smoky Red Pepper Crema
  • 1/2 cup sour cream
  • 1 tsp paprika
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
Steps
  1. Combine 1/2 cilantro, jalapeño, vinegar, water, sugar, and a pinch of salt; cover with plastic wrap and microwave for 1 minute. Stir and set aside to pickle.
  2. Cook rice in IP five minutes. Instant release pressure.
  3. Combine tomato, remaining cilantro, a big squeeze of lime, a large drizzle of olive oil, and chopped onion to taste. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
  4. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add beans and their liquid, Southwest Spice Blend, and butter. Season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until slightly thickened and beans are warmed through, 2-3 minutes.
  5. Fluff rice with a fork; stir in reserved cilantro and a pinch of lime zest. Divide rice and beans between bowls; top with pico de gallo, guacamole, and pickled jalapeño (draining first) in separate sections. Sprinkle with cheese and drizzle with red pepper crema. Top bowls with crispy onions and serve with remaining lime wedges on the side.
Pico de Gallo
Ingredients
  • 1 cup finely chopped white onion
  • 1 jalapeño finely chopped
  • ¼ cup lime juice
  • ¾ teaspoon fine sea salt, more to taste
  • 1 ½ pounds ripe red tomatoes, chopped
  • ½ cup finely chopped fresh cilantro
Pork Chop Sandwiches Every Plate
Ingredients
  • Pork Chops (boneless)
  • Yukon Yellow Potatoes (8 small ones) cut into ½-inch-thick wedges
  • Lime Juice
  • Garlic, chopped or 1 tbsp garlic powder
  • Garlic & herb seasoning
  • Olive oil
  • Salt & Pepper
  • Onion sliced into ½-inch-thick rounds
  • Potato Buns
  • Red Pepper Jam (I didn't use this -- look in the spice drawer)
  • 2 tbsp mayonnaise
  • ¼ cup ketchup
  • Southwest Spice
  • 1 tbsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp cumin
  • 1 tsp chili powder
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, garlic & herb seasoning, salt, and pepper. Roast on middle rack until browned and tender, 20-25 minutes.
  2. Combine mayonnaise , a squeeze of lime juice, and garlic in a small bowl.
  3. In a second small bowl, combine ketchup and ½ tsp Southwest Spice Blend.
  4. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add onion rounds and cook until deeply browned and tender, 2-3 minutes per side; season with salt and pepper.
  5. Pat pork dry with paper towels and place between 2 large pieces of plastic wrap. Pound with a mallet until about ¼ inch thick. Season generously with remaining Southwest Spice Blend, salt, and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil over medium-high heat. Add pork; cook until browned and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Add jam and turn pork to coat.
  6. Toast buns and spread garlic-lime aioli. Top with pork, onion rounds, and top buns. Divide sandwiches and potato wedges between plates. Serve with Southwest ketchup.
Balsamic-Glazed Meatballs Every Plate
Ingredients
  • 2 Garlic cloves, finely chopped
  • Ciabatta rolls
  • 1 cup Panko Breadcrumbs
  • Beef Stock Concentrate
  • 1 lb ground Beef
  • 4 tbsp Italian Seasoning
  • 2 tbsp Balsamic Vinegar
  • 4 tbsp ketchup
  • 2 tsp brown sugar
  • 4 cups fresh Green Beans
  • 2 tbsp butter (room temp)
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees.
  2. In a medium bowl, mix panko with stock concentrate and 2 TBSP water. Add beef, half the garlic, half the Italian Seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix to combine, then form into 10-12 1½-inch meatballs. Place on one side of a baking sheet.
  3. In a small bowl, combine vinegar, ketchup, and brown sugar. Brush or spoon glaze over meatballs
  4. Toss green beans on opposite side of sheet from meatballs with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast 15 minutes.
  5. Combine butter with remaining garlic, Italian Seasoning, salt, and pepper. Halve ciabatta crosswise, then halve each piece on a diagonal. Spread cut sides of ciabatta with garlic butter.
  6. Add ciabatta to pan and toast an additional 5 minutes.
Creamy Mushroom Steak Every Plate
Ingredients
  • Red or Yukon Potatoes, sliced into ¼-inch-thick rounds
  • olive oil
  • salt & pepper
  • White Mushrooms, thinly slices
  • 1/2 cup diced onion
  • 4 thin Steaks
  • Ranch Steak
  • 4 cups fresh Green Beans
  • Beef Stock Concentrate
  • ¼ cup water
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 1/4 cup Sour Cream
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Toss potatoes on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 8 minutes.
  2. Pat steak dry with paper towels; season all over with salt and pepper. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add steak and cook to desired doneness, 3-5 minutes per side. Set aside
  3. Once potatoes have roasted 8 minutes, toss green beans on baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast 10-12 minutes.
  4. Heat a drizzle of oil in pan used for steak over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms and cook, stirring, until browned and tender, 5-7 minutes. Add onion and another drizzle of oil. Cook, stirring, until softened, 1-2 minutes.
  5. Stir stock concentrate and water into pan with mushroom mixture. Simmer until slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in sour cream and butter. Season generously with pepper. Add steak back to pan.
Parmesan-Crusted Chicken Every Plate
Rated 5/5
Ingredients
  • 2 small Zucchini, slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons
  • 2 Garlic cloves
  • Yukon Potatoes, diced
  • Chicken Breasts
  • 2 cups Shredded Parmesan
  • 1 cup Panko Breadcrumbs
  • 2 tbsp Italian Seasoning
  • 1/2 cup Sour Cream
  • 4 tbsp butter
  • salt and pepper
  • olive oil
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Place potatoes and garlic cloves in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook until tender when pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Reserve ½ cup potato cooking liquid, then drain and return potatoes and garlic to pot.
  2. Pat chicken dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
  3. In a small bowl, combine Parmesan, half the panko, a large drizzle of olive oil, 1 tbsp Italian Seasoning, salt, and pepper. Spread tops of chicken with half the sour cream, then mound with panko mixture, pressing firmly to adhere (no need to coat the undersides).
  4. Toss zucchini on opposite side of sheet with a drizzle of olive oil, 1 tbsp Italian Seasoning, salt, and pepper. Roast 20 minutes.
  5. Meanwhile, mash potatoes and garlic with remaining sour cream and butter until smooth, adding splashes of reserved potato cooking liquid as needed. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Spicy Almond-And-Seed Salad Topper
Adapted from https://www.realsimple.com/food-recipes/browse-all-recipes/spicy-almond-and-seed-salad-topper-recipe
Ingredients
  • ½ cup sliced almonds
  • ½ cup raw shelled pumpkin seeds (pepitas)
  • ½ cup raw sunflower seeds
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • ½ teaspoon garlic powder
  • ½ teaspoon onion powder
  • ½ teaspoon kosher salt
  • Freshly ground black pepper
  • ¼ teaspoon cayenne (optional)
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. Stir together almonds, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, oil, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, several grinds of pepper, and cayenne (if using) in a large bowl. Spread in an even layer on prepared baking sheet. Bake until golden and fragrant, 12 to 14 minutes. Let cool on baking sheet, about 10 minutes.
  3. Sprinkle over salads or grain bowls.
Chicken Bubble Biscuit Bake Casserole
Ingredients
  • 3 cups cooked chopped chicken, or canned chicken
  • 2 cans cream of chicken soup
  • 1 1/2 cups sour cream
  • 1 cup grated cheese
  • 2 Tablespoons Ranch dressing mix
  • 1/4 cup cooked, chopped bacon
  • 1 (12 oz) can refrigerator Grands Jr Biscuits
  • Cup of frozen peas
  • 1 additional cup grated cheese for top of casserole
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 350°. Lightly spray a 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray. Set aside.
  2. Combine chicken, soup, sour cream, 1 cup grated cheese, Ranch dressing mix, and bacon. Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces. Toss with chicken mixture. Top with remaining cup of grated cheese.**
  3. Pour chicken mixture into prepared pan. Bake for 25-35 minutes, until bubbly and biscuits are golden brown.
Cauliflower & Zucchini Bake
Adapted from https://ohmyveggies.com/cauliflower-and-zucchini-bake/
Servings: 4
Ingredients
  • 1 large cauliflower, broken into evenly-sized florets
  • 1 tbsp butter, softened
  • 1 large zucchini, cut into slices
  • 1 large summer squash, cut into slices
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 2/3 cup creme fraiche
  • 1 large egg yolk
  • 3/4 cup Cheddar, grated
  • 1 cup Parmesan, shredded
  • rosemary sprigs, to garnish
  • kosher salt
  • freshly ground black pepper
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 375°F. Grease an oval baking dish with the softened butter.
  2. Blanch the cauliflower in a large saucepan of salted, boiling water for 4-5 minutes until tender to the point of a knife. Drain and refresh in iced water.
  3. Drain again and arrange in the baking dish with the sliced zucchini. Whisk together the cream, creme fraiche, egg yolk, Cheddar, and seasoning.
  4. Pour over the vegetables in the baking dish and scatter over the shredded Parmesan. Season with more salt and pepper.
  5. Bake for 35-45 minutes until golden-brown and bubbling at the edges. Remove from the oven and leave to cool briefly before garnishing with rosemary.
Sausage Breakfast Muffins
Ingredients
  • 1 pound roll of breakfast sausage
  • 4 eggs
  • 1 cup sharp Cheddar cheese shredded
  • 1 cup Bisquick baking mix
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 350F degrees. Grease a 12-cup muffin pan with non-stick cooking spray; set aside.
    2. Crumble the sausage into a skillet over medium-high heat and cook until no longer pink. Drain off the fat and set the sausage aside to cool slightly.
    In a large mixing bowl, lightly beat the eggs. Add the shredded cheese, Bisquick, and the fully cooked sausage; mix well.
    Fill the prepared muffin cups about ¾ full with the mixture. Bake for 18-20 minutes, or until golden brown on top.
Honey Sriracha Fried Chicken Every Plate
Ingredients
  • 2 Sweet Potatoes
  • 2 Zucchinis
  • 1/4 cup Sour Cream
  • 1 tbsp Honey
  • 2 tbsp Sriracha
  • 3 Chicken Breasts
  • 1 tbsp Garlic Powder
  • Vegetable Oil
  • 6 TBPS butter
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Peel and dice sweet potatoes into 1-inch pieces. Trim and slice zucchini into ½-inch-thick rounds.
  2. Place 1 cup flour in a shallow dish. Crack one egg (two eggs for 4) into a second shallow dish; whisk in 2 TBSP water. Season both dishes generously with salt and pepper.
  3. Toss zucchini on a baking sheet with a large drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Roast 15-18 minutes.
  4. Place sweet potatoes in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil; cook until tender, 12-15 minutes. Reserve ½ cup sweet potato cooking liquid; drain and return sweet potatoes to pot. Add sour cream and 2 TBSP butter; mash until smooth, adding splashes of reserved sweet potato cooking liquid as needed. Taste and season with salt and pepper.
  5. Melt 4 TBSP butter in a medium pan over medium-low heat. Add honey and Sriracha. Cook, stirring, until bubbling and glossy, 1-2 minutes. Transfer honey Sriracha sauce to a small bowl.
  6. Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Place between 2 large pieces of plastic wrap; pound with a mallet or heavy-bottomed pan until about ½ inch thick. Season all over with garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Working one piece at a time, press chicken into flour until fully coated. Gently shake off excess, then dip both sides into beaten egg. Let excess egg drip off, then press into flour again until fully coated.
  7. Heat a ⅓-inch layer of oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium-high heat. Once oil is hot enough that a pinch of flour sizzles when added to the pan, add coated chicken. Cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-5 minutes per side. Drizzle chicken with honey Sriracha sauce.
Sriracha Pork Stir-Fry Every Plate
Ingredients
  • 1 lb Ground Pork
  • Red Cabbage & Carrot Mix
  • Sweet Soy Glaze
  • Lime
  • Jasmine Rice
  • Scallions
  • Peanuts
  • Sriracha
  • Garlic
  • 3 clove
Steps
  1. In a small pot, combine rice, 2¼ cups water, and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce to a low simmer. Cook until rice is tender, 15-20 minutes. Keep covered off heat until ready to serve.
  2. While rice cooks, zest and quarter lime. Trim and thinly slice scallions, separating whites from greens. Peel and finely chop garlic. Roughly chop peanuts.
  3. In a small bowl, combine soy glaze, half the Sriracha (save the rest for serving), and juice from half the lime.
  4. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add scallion whites and garlic; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30 seconds. Add pork and season with salt and pepper. Cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until pork is browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Add cabbage and carrot mix and stir until slightly softened, 1-2 minutes.
  5. Add soy glaze mixture and 2 TBSP butter to pan. Stir until sauce has thickened and stir-fry is evenly coated, 1-2 minutes. Taste and season with salt and pepper if desired. Turn off heat.
  6. Fluff rice with a fork; stir in lime zest and 2 TBSP butter. Divide rice between bowls. Top with stir-fry and sprinkle with peanuts and scallion greens. Drizzle with as much remaining Sriracha as you like. Serve with remaining lime wedges on the side.
Crispy Avocado Tacos - Purple Carrot
Ingredients
  • 1 avocado, halved, peeled, and cut into 12 slices
  • 2 tbsp quick cooking polenta
  • 1 shallot, peeled and thinly sliced
  • 1 lime, juiced (divided)
  • 1 tbsp chimichurri blend (divided)
  • 1/3 cup Greek or Cashew milk Yogurt
  • 0.25 oz cilantro, leaves and tender stems roughly chopped (divided)
  • 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
  • 6 corn tortillas
  • 1 tbsp hot sauce
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 400°F. Brush 1 tbsp olive oil on baking sheet and place avocado in single layer. Add a pinch of salt and pepper and sprinkle with just half the polenta. Flip avocado over and repeat. Bake until avocado is crispy, 12 to 15 minutes. Leave oven on for step 4. (4-serving meal: use 2 tbsp olive oil).
  2. Stir together shallot, just 1 tbsp lime juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper in small bowl and set aside. In another small bowl, combine just 1 tsp chimichurri blend, remaining lime juice, yogurt, just half the cilantro, 2 tsp olive oil, and a pinch of salt and pepper and whisk until smooth. (4-serving meal: use 2 tbsp lime juice, 2 tsp chimichurri blend, 4 tsp olive oil).
  3. Combine black beans, remaining chimichurri blend, 1 tsp olive oil, ¼ cup water, and a pinch of salt and pepper in small saucepan over medium heat. Cook until beans are heated through, 3 to 5 minutes. Off heat, mash ¾ of beans with back of fork and cover to keep warm. (4-serving meal: use 2 tsp olive oil, ½ cup water). TIP: If the bean mixture is too stiff, add 1 tbsp water.
  4. Wrap tortillas in foil and place in oven until heated through, 5 to 6 minutes. Lay warmed tortillas on clean work surface. Spread refried black beans evenly on each tortilla and top with crispy avocado. Sprinkle with pickled shallot and remaining cilantro. Serve with chimichurri crema and hot sauce. Enjoy!
Udon with Mushrooms & Greens - Purple Carrot
Ingredients
  • 4 oz mushrooms, trimmed and thinly sliced
  • 1 tbsp agave
  • 2 tbsp butter
  • 2 garlic cloves, peeled and minced
  • 1 tbsp white sesame seeds
  • 1/4 cup peanuts
  • 14 oz udon noodles
  • 4 tsp tamari/soy sauce
  • 4 oz coleslaw blend
  • 4 oz teen spinach
  • 2 scallions, trimmed and thinly sliced
  • 1 tsp vegetable oil
  • Salt and pepper
Steps
  1. Bring medium saucepan of salted water to a boil for noodles.
  2. Add 1 tsp vegetable oil, mushrooms and a pinch of salt and pepper to large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook mushrooms until golden brown and dry, 7 to 8 minutes. Add just half the agave, just half the butter, garlic, sesame seeds, peanuts, and a pinch of salt and pepper and stir until combined, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to bowl and set aside. Wipe skillet clean and set aside. (4 serving meal: use 2 tsp vegetable oil).
  3. Add noodles to boiling water and cook until soft, 2 to 3 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop cooking process. In same skillet, add remaining butter, coleslaw blend, and spinach and cook over medium-high heat until greens are wilted, 3 to 4 minutes. Add noodles, remaining agave, tamari, and a pinch of salt and pepper and toss to coat.
  4. Divide noodles between bowls and top with sticky peanut mushrooms and scallions.
Spicy Green Burgers with Sesame Carrots - Favorite Purple Carrot
Ingredients
  • 3 carrots, peeled and cut into 3-inch sticks
  • 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
  • 1/2 tsp tuxedo sesame seeds
  • 1 tbsp Sriracha
  • 1/4 cup vegan mayo
  • 2 oz shredded green cabbage
  • 2 Actual Veggies® Green Burgers
  • 2 pretzel burger buns
  • 2 tsp vegetable oil
  • Salt
  • Peppers
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 425°F. Combine carrots, sesame oil, sesame seeds, and a pinch of salt and pepper on baking sheet and toss. Bake carrot fries until tender and browned in spots, 18 to 20 minutes.
  2. Stir together Sriracha and mayo in small bowl. In a medium bowl, combine just 3 tbsp Sriracha mayo and cabbage and toss to coat. (4-serving meal: use 6 tbsp Sriracha mayo)
  3. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add green burgers and cook until golden brown, 5 to 6 minutes per side. Transfer to plate and cover to keep warm. Wipe skillet clean.
  4. Place pretzel buns in same skillet, cut side down, and cook until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Transfer to serving plates. Place green burger on bottom half of each bun. Top with Sriracha slaw and close with top bun. Serve with carrot fries and remaining Sriracha mayo.
Parmesan-Crusted Chicken - Every Plate
Ingredients
  • Zucchini
  • Garlic
  • Potatoes
  • Chicken Breasts
  • Shredded Parmesan
  • Panko Breadcrumbs
  • Italian Seasoning
  • Sour Cream
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees. Dice potatoes into ½-inch pieces. Peel garlic. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise; slice crosswise into ½-inch-thick half-moons.
  2. Place potatoes and garlic cloves in a medium pot with enough salted water to cover by 2 inches. Bring to a boil and cook until tender when pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Reserve ½ cup potato cooking liquid, then drain and return potatoes and garlic to pot. Keep covered off heat until ready to mash.
  3. Pat chicken dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper; place on one side of a baking sheet. In a small bowl, combine Parmesan, half the panko, a large drizzle of olive oil, 2 tsp Italian Seasoning, salt, and pepper. Spread tops of chicken with sour cream, then mound with panko mixture, pressing firmly to adhere (no need to coat the undersides).
  4. Toss zucchini on opposite side of sheet from coated chicken with a drizzle of olive oil, 2 tsp Italian Seasoning, salt, and pepper. Roast 15-20 minutes.
  5. Mash potatoes and garlic with sour cream and 4 tbsp butter until smooth, adding splashes of reserved potato cooking liquid as needed. Season generously with salt and pepper.
Pork Sausage & Pepper Penne - Every Plate
Ingredients
  • Pork Sausage Mix
  • Bell Pepper
  • Penne Pasta
  • Tomato Paste
  • Garlic
  • 1 Onion
  • Shredded Parmesan
  • Cream Cheese
  • 2 tbsp butter
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Place butter in a small bowl to soften. Halve, core, and thinly slice bell pepper into strips. Peel garlic; place cloves in the center of a small piece of foil and cinch into a packet. Halve, peel, and thinly slice onion.
  2. Toss bell pepper on a baking sheet with a drizzle of oil, salt, and pepper. Place garlic foil packet on same sheet. Roast until bell pepper is tender and garlic is softened, 18-20 minutes.
  3. Cook pasta 9-11 minutes. Reserve ½ cup pasta cooking water.
  4. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add sliced onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender and lightly browned, 2-3 minutes. Add sausage; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper.
  5. Stir tomato paste into pan with onion and sausage until combined, 1 minute. Slowly stir in marinara and 1¼ cup plain water. Bring to a simmer, then stir in cream cheese and half the Parmesan until melted and combined. Season generously with salt and pepper. Reduce heat to low.
  6. Once garlic is roasted, mash cloves with a fork; stir into bowl with softened butter. Stir garlic butter, drained pasta, and bell pepper into sauce. If needed, stir in reserved pasta cooking water until pasta is coated in a creamy sauce. Season with salt and pepper. Divide between bowls and sprinkle with remaining Parmesan.
Chicken Sausage Pizza Bake
Ingredients
  • Buttermilk Biscuits
  • Chicken Sausage Mix
  • Garlic Powder
  • Marinara
  • Shredded Mozzarella
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Coat an 8-by-8-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. Quarter each biscuit.
  2. Heat a drizzle of oil in a medium pan over medium-high heat. Add sausage; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
  3. Meanwhile, toss quartered biscuits in a large bowl with garlic powder, half the marinara, and half the cheese. Transfer cooked sausage to bowl with biscuit mixture and toss to combine. Transfer sausage biscuit mixture to prepared baking dish.
  4. Top sausage biscuit mixture with remaining cheese; bake on middle rack until cheese is browned, biscuits are puffed, and edges are bubbling, 20-25 minutes.
  5. Place remaining marinara in a small microwave-safe bowl and cover loosely with a paper towel. Serve pizza with remaining marinara alongside for dipping.
Chicken Vesuvio
Ingredients
    * 1/4 cup olive oil
    * 4 chicken thighs with skin and bone (about 1.5 lb.)
    * Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
    * 1 lb. potato cut in chunks ( I used small red skin potato)
    * 4–5 garlic cloves thinly sliced
    * ½ cup dry white wine
    * ½ cup chicken stock
    * 2 Tablespoons salted butter
