    * ½ Tablespoon dried oregano
    * 1 teaspoon dried thyme
    * 1 teaspoon red crushed red pepper flakes-optional
    * 2/3 cup fresh or thawed frozen peas
    For serving:
    * fresh parsley-chopped
    * fresh lemon juice
Steps
  1. Over medium high heat, in a large ovenproof skillet, heat ¼ cup of olive oil.*
    2. Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper and place in the skillet. Cook for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown on all sides. Remove the chicken from the skillet.*
    Place potatoes chunks in the same skillet, season with oregano, thyme, red pepper flakes and cook until potatoes are golden brown on all sides (about 10 minutes) stirring occasionally.*
    Add sliced garlic and saute for one minute.*
    Add salted butter, white wine and chicken stock and deglaze the pan. Stir in peas. Simmer for 4-5 minutes.*
    Return the chicken in the pan and stir everything together and place the skillet in a preheated oven.*
    Bake 20-25 minutes at 375 F.*
    Serve with fresh parsley and drizzle with lemon juice if desired.*
Bang Bang Chicken
Ingredients
  • 1 ½ pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts
  • 1 cup cornstarch
  • 1 teaspoon salt
  • ½ teaspoon cracked pepper
  • 2 large eggs
  • 1 tablespoon water
    • FOR THE BANG BANG SAUCE:
  • ½ cup mayonnaise
  • ¼ cup Thai sweet chili sauce
  • ½ teaspoon sriracha more to taste
Steps
  1. Chop the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Pat dry with a paper towel.
    2. Add the cornstarch, salt, and pepper to a shallow dish and stir to combine
    Whisk the eggs and water together in a second shallow dish.
    Dip each piece of chicken into the cornstarch to coat. Dip in the egg, and then back into the cornstarch.
    Spray an air fryer basket with non-stick spray and arrange the chicken in an even layer, leaving space for air to flow between each piece.
    Spray chicken liberally with non-stick spray, making sure to coat each piece.
    Air fry at 380 degrees for 5 minutes.
    Flip chicken and spray again with non-stick spray. Continue cooking for 4-5 minutes or until an internal thermometer reads 165 degrees.
    TO MAKE THE SAUCE:
  2. Whisk together the mayonnaise, chili sauce, and sriracha until smooth.
    3. Taste and add additional sriracha, if desired, for more spice.
    TO SERVE:
  3. Drizzle the sauce over the chicken and serve
Rum glazed pecans
Ingredients
  • 2 cups pecan halves, lightly toasted
  • SPICE MIX
  • 2
  • tablespoons granulated sugar
  • 1
  • teaspoon kosher salt
  • 1
  • teaspoon ground cinnamon
  • 1⁄2
  • teaspoon ground cloves
  • 1⁄4
  • teaspoon ground allspice
  • RUM GLAZE
  • 2
  • tablespoons dark rum
  • 2
  • teaspoons vanilla extract
  • 1
  • teaspoon brown sugar
  • 1
  • teaspoon unsalted butter
Steps
  1. DIRECTIONS
    2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
    To make the spice mix, place the spices in a small bowl and mix to combine.
    To make the glaze, place the glaze ingredients in a medium-size saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat.
    Add the pecans to the saucepan and cook until they are well coated and the pan is almost dry, about 1 minute. Spoon the spice mix over the nuts, 1 tablespoon at a time, until they are well coated.
    Transfer the pecans to the prepared sheet, separate with your hands or a fork, and let sit until completely dried, at least 1 hour and up to overnight
Creamy Sausage Pasta
Ingredients
  • 4 cups penne noodles
  • 1 teaspoon salt - more to taste
  • 1 teaspoon olive oil
  • ▢ 1 pound ground Italian sausage - spicy or mild, your preference
  • ▢ 2 tablespoons butter
  • ▢ 3 teaspoons minced garlic
  • ▢ ½-1 cup sliced mushrooms - see note
  • ▢ 1 cup reduced sodium chicken broth
  • ▢ 1 cup heavy cream
  • ▢ cracked black pepper - to taste
  • ▢ ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese - optional
  • fresh parsley or thyme for garnish - optional
Steps
  1. In a deep skillet, or pot, bring 4 cups water to a boil. Stir in penne noodles along with 1 teaspoon salt. Boil 6-9 minutes until fork-tender. Drain, toss with 1 teaspoon oil, and set aside.
    2. In the same skillet you used for the pasta (or a new one if you used a pot) cook sausage over medium-high heat, breaking up with a spoon or spatula as it cooks, for 6-8 minutes or until completely browned. Use a slotted spoon to transfer to a bowl and cover to keep warm.
    Reduce heat to medium and add butter to the pan. Once melted, stir in garlic 1-2 minutes til fragrant. Add mushrooms and saute 3-4 minutes until very tender.
    Stir in chicken broth and heavy cream and simmer over medium-low heat until reduced (about 5-10 minutes).
    Stir in cooked sausage and noodles. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Top with parmesan and parsley or thyme if desired and serve
Sweet & Smokey BBQ Pork Tacos Every Plate
Ingredients
  • 1 can pineapple
  • 2 Roma tomatoes
  • 2 red onions
  • 2 limes
  • 1/3 cup Mayo
  • 1/3 cup sour cream
  • Water
  • 10 ounce ground pork
  • 2 tbsp Sweet & Smoky BBQ Seasoning
  • 1/2 cup BBQ sauce
  • Salt & pepper
  • Olive oil
  • 1 tsp brown sugar
Steps
  1. Wash and dry produce. Drain pineapple, reserving juice in a small bowl; roughly chop. Dice tomato into ½-inch pieces. Halve, peel, and dice onion into ¼-inch pieces. Zest and quarter lime.
  2. In a second small bowl, combine pineapple, tomato, 2 TBSP onion (4 TBSP for 4 servings), and a pinch of lime zest. Stir in a large drizzle of oil and a big squeeze of lime juice; season with salt and pepper to taste. In a third small bowl, combine sour cream, 1 TBSP mayonnaise (2 TBSP for 4), a squeeze of lime juice, and a pinch of lime zest. Add water 1 tsp at a time until mixture reaches a drizzling consistency. Season with salt and pepper.
  3. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add remaining onion and season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring, until softened, 2-3 minutes. Add pork; cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Drain any excess grease from pan if necessary. Add BBQ Seasoning, ¾ tsp salt (1½ tsp for 4 servings), and pepper to pan; cook, stirring, until fragrant, 30-60 seconds.
  4. Add BBQ sauce, reserved pineapple juice, and 1 tsp brown sugar (2 tsp for 4 servings) to pan with pork mixture; stir to combine. (No brown sugar? No problem! Swap in the same amount of white sugar instead.) Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 1-2 minutes.
  5. Wrap tortillas in damp paper towels and microwave until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds.
  6. Divide tortillas between plates; fill with BBQ pork mixture. Top with pineapple salsa and drizzle with lime crema. Serve tacos with any remaining lime wedges on the side.
Tomato Chicken Sausage Cavatappi
Ingredients
  • 2 red or yellow peppers
  • 2 garlic cloves
  • 3 cups pasta (cavatappi)
  • 18 oz chicken sausage
  • 4 tbsp tomato paste
  • 3 tsp garlic powder
  • 3/4 cup heavy cream
  • 4 tbsp butter
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Olive oil
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
  2. Slice bell pepper into 1/2” strips. Peel garlic.
  3. Drizzle pepper with oil and season with salt and pepper; rub to evenly coat. Place on a lightly oiled baking sheet.
  4. Place garlic clove in the center of a small piece of foil; drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. Cinch into a packet and place on same sheet. Roast 18-22 minutes. Mash garlic with a fork to form a paste.
  5. Cook pasta stirring occasionally, until al dente, 9-11 minutes. Reserve pasta cooking water, then drain.
  6. Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add sausage and cook, breaking up meat into pieces, until browned and cooked through, 4-6 minutes.
  7. Add tomato paste, garlic powder, ½ cup reserved pasta cooking water, stirring, until thickened, 2-3 minutes.
  8. Stir in pasta, peppers, mashed garlic, cream, and butter.
Balsamic Roast Beef
Adapted from https://addapinch.com/balsamic-roast-beef-recipe/
Servings: 8
Ingredients
  • 1 (3-4 pound) boneless roast beef (chuck or round roast)
  • 1 cup beef broth
  • 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
  • 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce
  • 1 tablespoon soy sauce
  • 1 tablespoon honey
  • 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes
  • 4 cloves garlic chopped
Steps
  1. Place roast beef into the insert of your slow cooker. In a 2-cup measuring cup, mix together all remaining ingredients. Pour over roast beef and set the timer for your slow cooker. (4 hours on High or 6-8 hours on Low)
  2. Once roast beef has cooked, remove from slow cooker with tongs into a serving dish. Break apart lightly with two forks and then ladle about 1/4 - 1/2 cup of gravy over roast beef.
  3. Store remaining gravy in an airtight container in the refrigerator for another use.
Pulled Pork Sliders
Ingredients
    COLESLAW INGREDIENTS:
  • 1/2 cup mayo
  • 1 tablespoon dijon mustard
  • 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1/2 tsp sea salt
  • 1 (9 oz.) package slaw (I like a cabbage/carrot mix)
  • 12 pack slider buns
  • 3 cups pulled pork, (or use store bought)
  • coleslaw, (recipe above)
  • 1/2 cup BBQ sauce, OPTIONAL & use more or less depending on how saucy you want the sliders
  • 1/4 cup butter
  • 2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce
  • 1/2 teaspoon onion salt or garlic salt
  • 1/2 teaspoon poppy seeds
Steps
    FOR COLESLAW:
  1. In a large mixing bowl, stir together mayo, mustard, apple cider vinegar, onion powder and sea salt. Toss in the coleslaw mix. Stir everything together until the slaw is completely coated in the dressing. I like to make this a couple of hours before serving, so the flavors have time to marinate together.
    2. FOR SLIDERS:
  2. Preheat oven to 375°F.
    3. Slice the slider buns in half and remove the top of the buns and set aside.
    Place the bottom half of the buns in a 9×13 dish. Layer the pulled pork over the the buns, top with BBQ sauce, if desired, and replace the top of the buns.
  3. In a small microwave safe bowl, add butter, Worcestershire sauce, onion salt and poppy seeds. Microwave for 30-60 seconds, or until completely melted.
    4. Slowly pour the butter mixture over the top of the buns. Alternatively, use a spoon to spoon out melted butter to ensure poppy seeds cover the bun tops. Cover the dish with foil and bake at 375° for 10 minutes.
  4. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
  5. Once sliders have cooled a few minutes, remove the bun tops, add a spoonful of slaw and replace tops.
Breakfast Egg Casserole
Ingredients
  • 1 (8-ounce) package refrigerated crescent rolls
  • 1 pound breakfast sausage
  • 8 large eggs
  • 1 ¼ cups milk , I use 2%
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • ¼ teaspoon garlic powder
  • ¼ teaspoon ground black pepper
  • 1/2-1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
  • ½ cup shredded Monterey Jack or Cheddar cheese
Steps
  1. Preheat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9×13-inch baking dish with nonstick spray.
  2. Unroll the crescent dough and place in the bottom of the baking dish. Press the seams together and press the edges up the sides if excess. Bake 5 minutes.
  3. In a large skillet, cook and crumble the sausage with a spatula over medium heat. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to absorb extra grease.
  4. In a large bowl, beat the eggs. Whisk in the milk, salt, garlic powder and pepper.
    5. Sprinkle the sausage over the dough. Spread the cheese evenly over the sausage. Pour the egg over the top.
  5. Bake 35 to 40 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes clean. Let cool a few minutes before serving.
HAWAIIAN HAM AND SWISS SLIDERS
Ingredients
  • 24 slices of deli honey ham
  • 6 slices of swiss cheese, cut into fourths
  • 1/3 cup mayonnaise
  • 1 tablespoon poppy seeds
  • 1 1/2 tablespoons dijon mustard
  • 1/2 cup butter melted
  • 1 tablespoon onion powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
  • 2 packages (12 count) KING'S HAWAIIAN Original Hawaiian Sweet Dinner Rolls
Steps
  1. Cut rolls in half and spread mayo onto 1 side of the rolls. Place a slice or two of ham and slice of swiss cheese in roll. Replace the top of the rolls and bunch them closely together into a baking dish.
  2. In a medium bowl, whisk together poppy seeds, dijon mustard, melted butter, onion powder and worcestershire sauce.
  3. Pour sauce over the rolls, just covering the tops. Cover with foil and let sit for 10 minutes.
  4. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. Uncover and cook for additional 2 minutes until tops are slightly browned and crisp. Serve warm.
Cream Cheese Chili Chicken Dip
Ingredients
  • • 2 cups cooked, shredded chicken (rotisserie chicken works well)
  • • 8 oz cream cheese (softened)
  • • 1 cup sour cream
  • • 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
  • • 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
  • • 1/2 cup diced green chilis (canned is fine)
  • • 1/4 cup diced jalapeños (adjust to taste)
  • • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
  • • 1/2 tsp onion powder
  • • 1/2 tsp smoked paprika (optional)
  • • Salt and pepper to taste
  • • Optional toppings: chopped cilantro, extra shredded cheese, or diced jalapeños
Steps
  1. 1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
    2. 2. In a mixing bowl, combine cream cheese, sour cream, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Mix until smooth.
    3. Stir in shredded chicken, green chilis, jalapeños, and 3/4 of the cheddar and mozzarella cheese. Mix until evenly combined.
    4. Transfer the mixture to an oven-safe dish. Spread evenly and top with the remaining cheddar and mozzarella cheese.
    5. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
    6. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly. Garnish with cilantro or additional toppings if desired.
    7. Serve warm with tortilla chips, crackers, or veggie sticks.
Broccoli Salad
Ingredients
  • ▢ 8 cups broccoli florets, chopped
  • ▢ ½ cup red onion, finely chopped
  • ▢ 16 oz bacon, cooked and crumbled
  • ▢ ½ cup craisins
  • ▢ ½ cup shelled sunflower seeds
  • Creamy Dressing
  • ▢ 1 cup mayo
  • ▢ 2 Tablespoon red wine vinegar
  • ▢ 3 Tablespoon sugar, (honey, or sweetener of choice)
  • ▢ salt and freshly ground black pepper
Pepper Jelly Cheese Dip
Ingredients
  • - 8 ounces cream cheese, softened
  • - 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, shredded
  • - 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
  • - 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
  • - 1/2 cup red pepper jelly
  • - 1/2 cup sour cream (optional)
  • - Chopped green onions for garnish (optional)
Steps
  1. 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
    2. 2. In a medium bowl, mix together cream cheese, cheddar cheese, garlic powder, and black pepper until well combined.
    3. Stir in red pepper jelly until smooth.
    4. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish or a cast-iron skillet.
    5. If using sour cream, dollop it on top of the cheese mixture.
    6. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
    7. Remove from oven and garnish with chopped green onions (if using).
Instant Pot chicken Thighs and Drumsticks
Ingredients
  • 2 thighs
  • 2 drumsticks
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Garlic powder
  • Minced onion
Steps
  1. Place frozen chicken in IP and sprinkle with seasonings.
  2. Set to pressure cook 5 minutes and then instant release steam.
  3. Place air fryer lid on and bake at 400 for 10 minutes.
  4. Replace pressure cooker lid and cook for 5 more minutes.
Blackened Cod & veggie rice (Stovetop & Instant Pot)
Ingredients
    For the rice:
  • 3 tablespoons butter
  • 1/2 cup diced onion
  • 1/4 cup diced celery
  • 1/4 cup diced bell pepper
  • 1/4 cup diced carrots
  • 1 tbsp minced garlic
  • 1/4 teaspoon of paprika
  • 1/4 teaspoon of dried basil
  • Salt & pepper to taste
  • 2 cups of chicken broth
  • 1 1/2 cup of white rice
    • For the cod:
  • 3-4 pieces fish (thawed)
  • 1 teaspoon Creole seasoning
  • 2 tablespoon avocado oil
  • 2 tablespoons butter
  • 1 tablespoon lemon juice
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • Salt & pepper
Steps
  1. Pat fish dry with paper towels and sprinkle one side with salt, pepper, and Creole.
  2. In the instant pot, heat butter and sauté onion, celery, bell pepper, and garlic for about 5 minutes. Stir in the seasonings and rice; toss well to coat.
  3. Once the rice is lightly golden, stir in the chicken broth. Set to Manual for 5 minutes and instant release - fluff with a fork.
  4. Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the fish seasoning side down and sprinkle unseasoned side with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and creole.
  5. Cook fish until light blackened, about 7 minutes. Flip and continue cooking until done (another 5-7 minutes).
Praline Pecans
Ingredients
  • 8 cups Crispix cereal
  • 2 cups pecan halves (salted preferred)
  • 1/2 cup packed brown sugar
  • 1/2 cup corn syrup
  • 1/2 cup butter
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
Steps
  1. In a medium saucepan, combine the brown sugar, corn syrup, and butter. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
  2. Let it boil for 2 minutes, then remove from heat. Stir in the baking soda and vanilla extract. The mixture will bubble up slightly—this is normal and helps create the light, crispy coating.
  3. Pour the praline mixture over the cereal and nuts in the bowl. Gently stir with a spatula to coat everything evenly.
  4. Spread the coated mixture evenly onto the prepared baking sheet. Bake in the preheated oven for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes to ensure even coating and prevent sticking.
  5. Remove from the oven and let the praline crunch cool completely on the baking sheet.
    6. Once cooled, break into bite-sized pieces and transfer to an airtight container for storage.
Warm Crack Chicken Dip
Ingredients
  • 2 cups cooked shredded chicken (rotisserie works great!)
  • 8 oz cream cheese, softened
  • 1 cup sour cream
  • 1 packet (1 oz) ranch seasoning mix
  • 1 ½ cups shredded cheddar cheese
  • ½ cup cooked and crumbled bacon
  • ½ cup chopped green onions
  • 1 teaspoon garlic powder (optional for extra flavor)
  • ½ teaspoon black pepper
  • 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese (for extra cheesiness!)
Steps
  1. Preheat Oven: Set your oven to 375°F (190°C).
    2. Mix Ingredients: In a large bowl, combine cream cheese, sour cream, ranch seasoning, garlic powder, and black pepper. Stir until smooth.
    Add Chicken & Cheese: Fold in shredded chicken, cheddar cheese, bacon, and green onions. Mix well.
    Bake: Transfer the mixture to a baking dish or oven-safe skillet. Top with shredded mozzarella cheese.
    Cook: Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the dip is hot and bubbly.
    Serve: Enjoy warm with crackers, tortilla chips, pita bread, or veggies!
    Slow Cooker Option: Mix everything together and cook on low for 2-3 hours or high for 1 hour until melted and creamy.
Chicken Bacon Ranch Tater Tot Casserole
Ingredients
  • • 6 slices cooked bacon, chopped
  • • 4 cooked, shredded chicken breasts
  • • 32 oz. frozen tater tots
  • • ½ cup ranch dressing
  • • 1 cup milk
  • • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour
  • • 3 tbsp butter
  • • 1½ cups shredded mild cheddar cheese
  • • Salt & pepper to taste
Steps
  1. Preheat Oven to 375°F
    2. Cook Bacon until crispy and chop.
    Melt butter in a saucepan. Stir in flour, then gradually whisk in milk until thickened. Remove from heat and mix in ranch dressing, salt, and pepper.
    In a bowl, mix chicken, bacon, and half of the cheese. Pour in the ranch sauce and stir.
    In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, spread tater tots, then top with chicken mixture.
    Sprinkle remaining cheese on top.
    Bake for 30-35 minutes until bubbly and golden brown.
Bacon Ranch Chicken Salad
Adapted from https://www.spendwithpennies.com/bacon-ranch-chicken-salad/
Servings: 2 sandwiches
Ingredients
  • 2 cups cooked chicken chopped
  • 1/4 cup ranch dressing
  • 1/4 cup mayonnaise
  • 1 teaspoon yellow mustard or dijon
  • 1 teaspoon each parsley, dill
  • 3 strips bacon cooked & crumbled
  • 1 stalk celery chopped
  • 1 green onion
  • seasoned salt to taste
Steps
  1. Place all ingredients except for ranch dressing in a small bowl and mix well.
  2. Add the ranch dressing a little at a time to reach desired consistency.
  3. Serve on rolls with fresh tomatoes and lettuce.
Rotel dip
Ingredients
  • 1 can (10 oz) Rotel tomatoes, drained
  • 1 cup sour cream
  • 8 oz cream cheese, softened
  • 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
  • 1 packet ranch seasoning mix
  • ¼ cup diced jalapeños (optional)
  • ¼ cup chopped green onions
  • 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro
Steps
  1. In a large mixing bowl, combine sour cream, softened cream cheese, and ranch seasoning. Mix until smooth and creamy.
    2. Fold in the drained Rotel tomatoes, shredded cheddar cheese, diced jalapeños, and chopped green onions.
    Mix until all ingredients are evenly combined.
    Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
    Before serving, stir well and garnish with cilantro if desired.
    Serve with tortilla chips, crackers, or fresh veggie sticks.
Creamy Chicken & Rice Casserole
Ingredients
  • 2 cups cooked chicken (shredded or cubed)
  • 1 cup uncooked long-grain rice
  • 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of chicken soup
  • 1 can (10.5 oz) cream of mushroom soup
  • 2 cups chicken broth
  • 1/2 cup milk
  • 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese (plus extra for topping)
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • Salt and pepper to taste
  • 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs (for topping)
  • 2 tbsp butter (melted)
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13-inch casserole dish.
    2. In a large bowl, combine the uncooked rice, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, chicken broth, milk, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Stir until smooth.
    Fold in the cooked chicken and 1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese. Mix well to ensure everything is evenly coated.
    Pour the mixture into the prepared casserole dish and spread it evenly.
    Sprinkle additional shredded cheddar cheese over the top.
    In a small bowl, combine panko breadcrumbs and melted butter. Sprinkle this mixture evenly over the cheese layer.
    Cover the casserole dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the top is golden brown.
Dips
Ingredients
  • Four homemade vegetable dips
  • Recipes
  • 1. Buffalo Veggie Dip
  • 8 oz cream cheese, softened
  • ½ cup sour cream or Greek yogurt
  • ½ cup buffalo hot sauce (like Frank’s RedHot)
  • 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese
  • ½ tsp garlic powder
  • ½ tsp onion powder
  • ¼ tsp smoked paprika
  • ¼ cup crumbled blue cheese
  • 2 tbsp chopped green onions (for garnish)
    • Instructions:
  • In a mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese and sour cream (or Greek yogurt) until smooth and creamy.
  • Stir in the buffalo hot sauce, cheddar cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika until well combined
  • Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with green onions.
  • Serve immediately with fresh veggies like celery, carrots, bell peppers, or cucumber slices. You can also enjoy it with crackers or tortilla chips.
  • 2. Avocado Ranch Dip
    • Ingredients:
  • 2 ripe avocados, mashed
  • 1/2 cup sour cream
  • 1/4 cup ranch dressing
  • 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice
  • 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
  • Salt and pepper to taste
  • 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro (optional)
    • Instructions:
  • In a mixing bowl, mash the ripe avocados until smooth, leaving a few chunks if you prefer some texture.
  • Stir in the sour cream and ranch dressing. Mix until well combined.
  • Add the lime juice, garlic powder, salt, and pepper to taste. Mix until smooth and adjust seasoning as desired.
  • Optionally, sprinkle with fresh chopped cilantro for extra flavor.
  • Serve with fresh vegetable sticks like carrots, celery, cucumber, or tortilla chips
  • Enjoy this creamy, flavorful dip!
  • 3. Dill Dip
  • 1 cup sour cream
  • 1 cup mayonnaise (or Greek yogurt for a lighter version)
  • 2 tbsp fresh dill, chopped (or 2 tsp dried dill)
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp dried parsley
  • ½ tsp salt
  • ¼ tsp black pepper
  • 1 tbsp lemon juice (optional, for extra freshness)
    • Instructions:
  • In a medium bowl, mix together the sour cream, mayonnaise, and lemon juice (if using).
  • Add the dill, garlic powder, onion powder, parsley, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine.
  • Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour to let the flavors blend.
  • Serve chilled with fresh veggies, crackers, or chips.
  • 4. Ranch Dip
  • 1 cup sour cream
  • ½ cup buttermilk (for extra tang)
  • ½ cup mayonnaise
  • 1 tsp dried dill
  • 1 tsp dried parsley
  • 1 tsp garlic powder
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • ½ tsp salt
  • ¼ tsp black pepper
  • ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce (optional, for depth of flavor)
  • 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice or white vinegar
    • Instructions:
  • In a bowl, whisk together the sour cream, buttermilk, and mayonnaise until smooth.
  • Add the dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
  • Mix in the Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice (or vinegar) for extra depth.
  • Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to enhance the flavors.
  • Serve chilled with veggies, chips, or as a dressing for salad.
Sheet One-Pan Turmeric Tuna with Sweet Potato, Spinach, Zucchini & Peppers CHAT
Ingredients
  • 2 tuna steaks (6 oz each)

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F.

GRILLED ZUCCHINI NACHOS
Ingredients
  • 4 medium zucchini, sliced into 1/4-inch thick rounds

SPICED PECAN GRILLED PEACH SALAD
Ingredients
    Spiced Pecans:
  • 1 large egg white
  • 3 tablespoons dark brown sugar
  • 1 teaspoon cinnamon
  • 1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper
  • 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt
  • 2 cups pecan halves
    • Salad:
  • 1/4 cup, plus 2 teaspoons, extra-virgin olive oil, divided
  • 1/4 cup white wine vinegar
  • 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard
  • 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
  • 1/8 teaspoon kosher salt
  • Pepper, to taste
  • 2 large peaches, halved and pits removed
  • 6 cups mixed baby greens (arugula, spring mix and spinach)
  • 4 ounces soft goat cheese
Steps
  1. To make spiced pecans: Preheat oven to 275 degrees. Line rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.
    2. In medium bowl, whisk egg white, brown sugar, cinnamon, cayenne pepper and salt until well combined. Fold in pecans and mix until evenly coated in mixture. Spread in single layer on prepared baking sheet.
    Bake 45 to 50 minutes, stirring occasionally until pecans are fragrant and golden brown. Allow to cool completely.
    To make salad: Heat grill to medium-high heat. In small bowl, whisk 1/4 cup olive oil, white wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, garlic powder, salt and pepper, to taste. Set aside.
    Brush cut sides of peach halves with remaining olive oil and grill until grill lines appear and peaches become tender, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove peaches and cut into slices.
    Divide greens among four plates. Top with grilled peach slices and goat cheese. Divide 1 cup spiced pecans evenly among salads and reserve remaining cup for snacking. Drizzle each salad with vinaigrette.

Creamy Chicken Broccoli Alfredo Baked Ziti (Ally’s favorite)

  1. Preheat oven to 375°F.

Cheese and Bacon-Crusted Chicken Meal Plan
Ingredients
  • 12 oz. Green Beans
  • 12 oz. Boneless Skinless Chicken Breasts
  • 1 oz. Crispy Fried Onions
  • 1 oz. Shredded Cheddar-Jack Cheese
  • 1 oz. Cream Cheese
  • 1 oz. Bacon Bits
  • ⅗ oz. Butter
  • ½ tsp. Garlic Salt
Steps
  1. Trim green beans, if necessary. In provided tray, combine green beans, 2 tsp. olive oil, and garlic salt in 9x13 pan. Spread into an even layer. Cover tray with foil.
  2. Bake covered in hot oven, 15 minutes.
  3. Place cream cheese in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave uncovered until soft, 10-15 seconds.
  4. After 15 minutes, carefully remove tray from oven. Drain any excess liquid and push green beans to one side.
  5. Pat chicken dry and season both sides with a pinch of salt and pepper. Place chicken in now-empty side of tray. Top evenly with softened cream cheese, shredded cheese, then bacon.
  6. Bake uncovered in hot oven until green beans are tender and chicken reaches a minimum internal temperature of 165 degrees, 20-25 minutes.
  7. Carefully remove tray from oven. Transfer chicken to a plate. Stir butter into green beans until melted and combined.
  8. To serve, garnish green beans with crispy onions.
Sausage and Artichoke Pasta Meal Plan
Ingredients
  • 8 oz. Italian Pork Sausage
  • 4 fl. oz. Cream Sauce Base
  • 8 oz. Cooked Cavatappi Pasta **
  • 2 oz. Artichoke Hearts
  • 1 oz. Shredded Parmesan Cheese
  • 1 oz. Cream Cheese
  • ⅘ oz. Lemon Garlic Butter
  • ¼ cup Panko Breadcrumbs
  • 2 tsp. Garlic Pepper
  • 0.14 oz. Lemon Juice
Steps
  1. Place sausage in 9x13 pan and break up into bite-sized pieces using hands. Top with 1 tsp. olive oil.
  2. Bake uncovered in hot oven, 10 minutes.
  3. Cook pasta according to package.
  4. Break artichokes into bite-sized pieces using hands.
  5. Carefully remove tray from oven and drain excess liquid.
  6. Add cooked pasta, artichokes, cream base, garlic pepper, cream cheese, 1/4 cup water, and half the shredded cheese (reserve remaining for garnish). Stir to combine and cover tray with foil.
  7. Bake 10-15 minutes.
  8. While meal bakes, combine panko and 1 tsp. olive oil on a microwave-safe plate. Microwave until golden-brown and toasted, 60-90 seconds, stirring once halfway through.
  9. Carefully remove plate from microwave and tray from oven. Uncover tray and stir lemon juice and butter into pasta until melted and combined.
  10. To serve, top pasta with toasted panko and remaining shredded cheese.
Hatch Chile & Cheese-Stuffed Beef Meatloaf Meal Plan
Ingredients
  • 10 oz. Ground Beef
  • 8 oz. Cooked White Rice
  • 3 oz. Peas
  • 2 oz. Chipotle Crema
  • 2 oz. Shredded Quesadilla Cheese
  • 2 oz. Cream Cheese
  • 1 oz. Fire-Roasted Diced Hatch Green Chile Peppers
  • ¼ cup Panko Breadcrumbs
  • ⅗ oz. Butter
  • 1 tsp. Portuguese Piri Piri Blend
Steps
  1. Cook rice according to package.
  2. In 9x13 pan, combine rice, piri piri seasoning (use less if spice-averse), and peas.
  3. Push to one side of tray and evenly top with butter.
  4. In a mixing bowl, combine softened cream cheese, chile peppers (use less if spice-averse), and half the shredded cheese (reserve remaining for topping). Set aside.
  5. In another mixing bowl, combine ground beef, panko, 2 Tbsp. water, 1/4 tsp. salt, and a pinch of pepper.
  6. Form beef mixture into 2 equally-sized, oval-shaped loaves, about 3" in length and 2" in height.
  7. Press your thumb into center of each oval and place half the cheese mixture into center of each meatloaf. Close meat around cheese and re-form into ovals. Form a tight seal so cheese stays inside meat.
  8. Place meatloaves in empty side of tray. Cover rice side with foil.
  9. Bake half-covered (rice covered, meatloaves uncovered) in hot oven 20-25 minutes.
  10. Carefully remove from oven. Uncover rice and drain any excess liquid. Evenly top meatloaves with remaining shredded cheese.
  11. Bake again uncovered in hot oven until cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes.
  12. Carefully remove from oven.
  13. To serve, top meatloaf with crema.
Instant Pot Method for Thawing & Cooking Thick Steaks (1–1.5 inches thick, frozen)
Ingredients
  • 2 frozen steaks (1 to 1.5 inches thick)
  • Salt, pepper, garlic powder (or your preferred seasonings)
  • 1 tbsp oil (olive or avocado)
  • 1 cup beef broth or water (for pressure cooking)
  • Optional: Worcestershire, butter, herbs
Steps
  1. Turn on Sauté mode and add oil.
  2. Sear each frozen steak for 1–2 minutes per side (you won’t get a deep sear while frozen, but it helps start the flavor).
  3. Season with salt and pepper once one side is thawed enough. Remove from pot.
  4. Cancel sauté mode. Add 1 cup beef broth or water to the pot.
  5. Put a trivet or steamer rack inside the pot and place steaks on it (keeps them out of the liquid and prevents boiling them).
    6. Cook on High Pressure for 10–14 minutes, depending on thickness and how well-done you want them:
  6. 10 min = medium-rare
  7. 12 min = medium
  8. 14 min = medium-well
  9. Natural Release for 5 Minutes. Then quick release the rest of the pressure.
  10. To add a finishing crust, quickly sear the cooked steaks in a hot skillet or back on Sauté mode with butter and herbs (1 minute per side).
  11. After cooking, add a pat of butter, minced garlic, and thyme or rosemary while searing for that steakhouse finish.
Creamy Mushroom and Bacon Skillet
Ingredients
  • 6 slices bacon, chopped
  • 2 cups sliced mushrooms (baby bella or white)
  • 2 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
  • 1 tsp Italian seasoning (or thyme + parsley)
  • Salt and black pepper, to taste
  • 1 tbsp butter (optional, for extra richness)
  • Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish)
Steps
  1. In a large skillet, cook chopped bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove and set aside, leaving 1–2 tablespoons of bacon grease in the pan.
    2. Add mushrooms to the skillet and cook for 5–6 minutes until browned and softened. Add the onion (if using) and cook until translucent.
    Stir in the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
    Lower the heat, pour in the cream, and stir in Parmesan and Italian seasoning. Simmer 3–4 minutes until slightly thickened.
    Add the bacon back in and stir to combine. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.
    Add butter if you want a silkier sauce, then sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Broccoli + Mushroom Tagliatelle Alfredo HungryRoot

  • Classic Alfredo Sauce
  • Broccoli Florets
  • Baby Bella Mushrooms

  1. Boil a large pot of salted water, add half the box of pasta + cook 4-6 min or until al dente, then drain + return to pot
  2. Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp oil in skillet over med-high; add half the bag of broccoli, salt/pep + sauté 4-5 min until lightly browned; add 2 tbsp water, reduce heat, cover + steam 3-5 min more until tender; set aside
  3. Wipe mushrooms clean + thinly slice; heat 1 tbsp oil in skillet over high, add mushrooms + cook undisturbed 3 min; sauté 3-4 min until browned + tender, season with salt/pep; add broccoli + ½ cup sauce to mushrooms + heat 2 min
  4. Toss pasta with sauce + divide to plates
MUSH Overnight Oats
Ingredients
  • 1 serving – about 1 cup
  • ½ cup old-fashioned rolled oats (not quick oats)
  • ⅓ cup unsweetened almond milk (less than normal to keep it thick)
  • 2 tablespoons unsweetened applesauce (MUSH uses this for natural sweetness and softness)
  • 1 teaspoon maple syrup or date syrup
  • ¼ teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Pinch of salt
  • Optional for creaminess: 1 tablespoon plain or vanilla protein powder or ground flaxseed
  • 5 single-serving cups – ~1 cup each
  • Rolled oats (old-fashioned) 2 ½ cups

  • Unsweetened applesauce ⅔ cup
  • Maple syrup 2 ½ tbsp
  • Vanilla extract 1 ¼ tsp
  • Salt ½ tsp
  • vanilla protein powder ⅓ cup
Steps
  1. In a small bowl or jar, stir together oats, almond milk, applesauce, syrup, vanilla, salt, and optional protein powder or flaxseed.
  2. The mixture should look a little dry. (It’ll soften overnight.)
  3. Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.
    4. In the morning, stir well. Eat cold.
  4. Texture Tricks
    5. Less liquid = thicker oats. If it’s too thick the next day, add 1–2 tablespoons milk before eating.
  5. Applesauce or mashed banana gives that naturally creamy, slightly chewy texture.
    6. Flavor Add-ins:
  6. Blueberry: ¼ cup mashed blueberries + ¼ teaspoon lemon juice
  7. Vanilla Bean: ½ teaspoon vanilla + 1 tablespoon vanilla protein powder
  8. Dark Chocolate: 1 teaspoon cocoa powder + 1 teaspoon maple syrup
  9. Coffee: Replace 2 tablespoons of milk with cold brew coffee
  10. Peanut Butter: 1 tablespoon creamy peanut butter + 1 teaspoon honey
Garlic Parmesan Chicken Spaghetti in Spicy Cajun Cream Sauce
Ingredients
  • 2 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts, sliced into strips
  • 12 oz spaghetti
  • 1 tbsp olive oil
  • 4 tbsp butter, divided
  • 6 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1 tsp Salt
  • 1/8 tsp black pepper
  • ½ cup grated Parmesan (for crusting the chicken)
  • 1½ cups heavy cream
  • ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth
  • 1 cup shredded mozzarella
  • 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar
  • ¾ cup grated Parmesan (for sauce)
  • 2 oz cream cheese, softened
  • ½ tsp Italian seasoning to
  • ½ tsp dried basil
  • ¼ tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional)
  • Fresh chopped parsley, for garnish
Steps
  1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until just al dente. Drain, toss lightly with olive oil, and set aside so it doesn’t stick.
  2. Pat chicken dry, then season generously with Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Press the grated Parmesan onto the chicken pieces to create a light crust.
  3. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil and 2 tablespoons of butter over medium high heat. Add the chicken and sear for about 4–6 minutes, flipping as needed, until the pieces are cooked through and beautifully golden.
  4. Toss in 1 tablespoon of butter and half the garlic during the last minute of cooking. Stir it around until that garlic gets buttery and fragrant. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set it aside.
  5. Drop the remaining tablespoon of butter into the same skillet. Add the rest of the garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
  6. Pour in the heavy cream and chicken broth. Stir and bring it to a simmer.
  7. Add the cream cheese and whisk until fully melted and smooth. Slowly stir in the mozzarella, cheddar, and Parmesan cheeses. Season with Italian seasoning, dried basil, and red pepper flakes if you like a little heat. Taste and adjust with salt and pepper as needed.
    8. Let the sauce simmer for 2–3 more minutes until it thickens and gets rich.
  8. Add the cooked spaghetti straight into the sauce. Use tongs to toss and coat the pasta in the cheesy Cajun sauce. Let it sit over low heat for another minute to soak up the flavor.
  9. Plate the cheesy spaghetti and top it with the parmesan chicken strips. Sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Dill Pickle Dip
Ingredients
  • 32 ounces sour cream
  • 16 ounces cream cheese
  • 1 teaspoon onion powder
  • 1 teaspoon garlic powder
  • 4 tablespoons ranch seasoning
  • Salt, to taste
  • 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce
  • 4 tablespoons pickle juice
  • 2 cups dill pickles, chopped
  • 4 to 6 tablespoons fresh dill
Steps
  1. In a bowl, combine the sour cream and cream cheese using a handheld mixer. Add the onion powder, garlic powder, ranch seasoning, Worcestershire sauce and pickle juice and stir. Add salt to taste. Fold in the pickles and dill. Top the dip with fresh dill. Serve with chips, veggies or crackers.
Whipped Feta with Honey Dip
Ingredients
  • 4 ounces feta cheese
  • 4 ounces cream cheese, softened
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 1/2 teaspoon garlic, minced
  • 1/2 teaspoon dried basil
  • 1/4 cup honey
  • 1 tablespoon pistachios, chopped
  • 1 teaspoon chives, finely chopped
  • 1/2 teaspoon cracked black pepper
Steps
  1. In a food processor, combine feta, cream cheese and olive oil until cheeses are well combined and smooth. Add basil and garlic mixing well.
    2. Scoop cheese onto a small plate or into a shallow bowl. Use a large spoon to create a well in the center of the cheese. Fill the well with honey. Garnish the sides of the well with pistachios, chives and black pepper. Serve with warm pieces of pita bread.
Fruit Dip
Ingredients
  • 5.3 ounces Greek yogurt
  • 3 tablespoons almond or peanut butter
  • 1 tablespoon honey
  • 1 teaspoon cinnamon
Steps
  1. Add yogurt, almond or peanut butter, honey and cinnamon to a small bowl. Stir to combine. Serve with apple slices, graham crackers, pretzels or cookies.
Favorite carrots
Ingredients
  • 3 carrots, peeled and cut
  • 1 tbsp toasted sesame oil
  • 1/2 tsp tuxedo sesame seeds
Steps
  1. Preheat oven to 425°F. Combine carrots, sesame oil, sesame seeds, and a pinch of salt and pepper on baking sheet and toss. Bake carrot fries until tender and browned in spots, 18 to 20 minutes.
Teriyaki Chicken Bowls
Ingredients
  • 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cubed
  • 2 Tbsp olive oil
  • 2 (12-oz) pkg stir-fry vegetables (broccoli, carrots, and snow peas)
  • 2 red bell peppers, sliced
  • I cup teriyaki sauce
  • 2 Ready in 90 seconds brown rice bags

  1. Cook chicken in hot oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat 6 minutes or until browned.

EMeals Chicken Almondine Sugar Snap Peas and Rice

EMeals Sticky Molasses Chicken Shaved Brussels Sprouts Salad
Ingredients
  • 2 (12-oz) pkg rainbow baby carrots
  • 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, halved lengthwise
  • 1/2 cup olive oil split

  • ½ tsp pepper

  • 1 (1½-Ib) pkg shaved Brussels sprouts

Classic Philly Cheesesteak
Ingredients
  • 1 lb ribeye steak (boneless)
  • 2 hoagie rolls (Amoroso-style if you can find them)
  • 1 medium yellow onion, thinly sliced (optional but very common)
  • 1 medium green pepper
  • 4–6 slices provolone cheese
  • 1–2 tbsp oil (canola or vegetable)
  • Salt & black pepper, to taste
Steps
  1. Freeze the ribeye for 20–30 minutes—this makes thin slicing easier.
    2. Slice the steak paper-thin, against the grain.
    Heat a large skillet or flat-top over medium-high heat.
    Add oil, then onions & peppers (if using).
    Cook until soft and lightly browned, about 5–7 minutes. Push to the side.
    Add the steak in a single layer.
    Season with salt and pepper.
    Cook 1–2 minutes, then chop and flip with a spatula until just cooked through.
    Mix onions back in.
    Lay cheese over the meat, let it melt (cover pan briefly if needed).
Air Fryer “Long John Silver’s” Cod
Ingredients
  • 1 lb cod fillets (thawed & patted very dry)
  • ¾ cup all-purpose flour
  • ¼ cup cornstarch
  • 1 tsp baking powder
  • 1 tsp salt
  • ½ tsp sugar
  • 1 tsp onion powder
  • 1 tsp paprika
  • 1 tsp pepper
  • 1 cup cold club soda (or cold water)
  • Non-stick spray
  • Copycat Tartar Sauce (Quick)
  • • ½ cup mayo
  • • 2 Tbsp sweet relish
  • • 1 tsp lemon juice
  • • Pinch salt & pepper
Steps
  1. Preheat air fryer to 400°F for 5 minutes.
    2. Whisk dry ingredients. Slowly add cold club soda until batter is thick but pourable (like pancake batter). Cold = crispier.
    Pat very dry.
    Dip each piece into batter, let excess drip off.
    Spray basket with oil (heavy).

Slow Cooker Pulled Pork (Boneless Pork Loin)
Ingredients
  • • 2½–4 lb boneless pork loin
  • • 1 cup chicken broth (or apple juice for a sweeter version)
  • • ½ cup BBQ sauce (plus more for serving)
  • • 1 small onion, sliced
  • • 3 cloves garlic, minced
  • • 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
  • • 1 tbsp brown sugar
  • • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • • 1 tsp chili powder
  • • 1 tsp salt
  • • ½ tsp black pepper
  • • Optional: ½ tsp cumin or dry mustard
  • ⸻
  • Instructions
  • 1. Prep the slow cooker
  • • Place sliced onion and garlic in the bottom.
  • • Pour in the chicken broth.
  • 2. Season the pork
  • • Mix salt, pepper, paprika, chili powder, brown sugar, and any optional spices.
  • • Rub seasoning all over the pork loin.
  • 3. Cook
  • • Place pork on top of onions.
  • • Pour vinegar and BBQ sauce over the pork.
    • • Cover and cook:
  • • LOW for 6–7 hours (best option)

  • The pork is ready when it reaches 195–200°F and pulls apart easily.

Crusty Artisan Bread
Adapted from https://www.onceuponachef.com/recipes/crusty-artisan-bread.html#tabbox
Servings: 3 loaves
Ingredients
  • 6-1/2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 4 teaspoons salt
  • 1-1/2 tablespoons instant/rapid-rise yeast
  • 3 cups lukewarm water
  • Cornmeal, for dusting the pan
Steps
  1. In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and yeast. Add the water and stir until the mixture is moist, without any patches of flour.
  2. The dough should be sticky and conform to the shape of the bowl. If your dough is too dry, add a few tablespoons more warm water. If it's too wet, add a few tablespoons of flour.
  3. Cover the bowl loosely with plastic wrap and let it sit on the counter in a warm spot for 2 hours.
  4. Dust a baking sheet with cornmeal.
  5. Dust the surface of the dough and your hands lightly with flour. Pull out one-third of the dough and coat the outside lightly with flour (you don't want to incorporate more flour into the dough, you just want to be able to handle it).
  6. Gently work the dough into a smooth ball, stretching the surface and tucking the ends underneath, adding more flour as needed so it doesn't stick to your hands.
  7. Put the dough ball onto the prepared baking sheet and let it rest at room temperature, uncovered, for about 40 minutes.
  8. Preheat the oven to 450°F. Set one rack in the lowest position of the oven and one rack in the middle position. Place a metal pan on the bottom rack. (You will fill this with water later to create steam in the oven).
  9. Generously dust the dough with flour. Using a sharp knife, make a few 1/2-inch-deep slashes in the dough -- a scallop, cross, or tic tac toe pattern.
  10. Slide the baking sheet with the dough into the oven, and carefully fill the metal cake pan with one cup of hot tap water.
  11. Bake until the loaf is golden brown, about 30 minutes. Cool completely on a wire rack.
Notes
  • Note: Active dry yeast may be used instead of instant/rapid-rise yeast, however, the dough will take longer to rise. To give active dry yeast a boost, you can dissolve it in the lukewarm water and let it sit until frothy, about 10 minutes. After that, add it to the flour and salt, and proceed with the recipe.
Creamy Parmesan Chicken and Orzo
Ingredients
  • 1 lb chicken breast, cubed
  • 1 cup orzo pasta
  • 2 cups chicken broth
  • 1 cup heavy cream
  • 1 cup Parmesan cheese, grated
  • 2 cloves garlic, minced
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • Salt and pepper to taste
  • Fresh parsley for garnish
Steps
  1. In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add chicken and season with salt and pepper. Cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and set aside.
  2. In the same skillet, add garlic and sauté for 1 minute. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
  3. Stir in orzo and reduce heat, simmering for about 10 minutes until orzo is tender.
  4. Add heavy cream and Parmesan cheese, stirring until creamy. Return chicken to the skillet.
  5. Serve garnished with parsley.
